barrow_draugr.lore: Buried with its axe so it could keep fighting. It does.

plague_wolf.name: Plague Wolf

bite.name: Plague Bite
bite.text: 6 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

plague_wolf.lore: The barrow wolves carry the old plague in their teeth.

frostbit_leper.name: Frostbitten Leper

touch.name: Unclean Touch

rot.name: The Rot Spreads
rot.text: 1 Volatile Toxin to a random hero

frostbit_leper.lore: It rings its bell to warn you. You should have listened.

mold_wight.name: Mould Wight

claw.name: Smothering Claw
claw.text: 7 and 1 Toxin to the front hero

mold_wight.lore: The mould grew a shape in the dark, and the shape grew hungry.

grave_worm.name: Grave Worm

feed.text: 6 and 1 Toxin to the rearmost hero; heals itself

sink.name: Sink into the Grave
sink.text: gains 8 Block, dodges the next hit

grave_worm.lore: It eats the dead. It has eaten so many that it has started to look like them.

clods.name: Frozen Clods
clods.text: 5 and 1 Weaken to the rearmost hero

gravedigger.lore: He dug graves in the barrow until there was no floor left. Then he started on the walls.

the_swollen.name: The Swollen

sheet.name: Frozen Sheet
sheet.text: 5 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

creak.name: The Bubo Creaks
creak.text: 1 Toxin to the two front heroes

the_swollen.lore: The plague sores kept growing in the cold. They are waiting for the thaw.

court_fool.name: Court Fool

joke.name: The Only Joke
joke.text: 4 stress to every hero; builds 1 Joke

punch.name: The Punchline
punch.text: 10 stress to every hero; spends its Joke

court_fool.lore: He kept the court laughing while the doors were sealed. It is the only joke he remembers.

kings_hawk.name: The King's Hawk

bate.name: Bate to the Leash
bate.text: 7 and 2 Toxin to the hero who acted last

rake.name: Swollen Talons
rake.text: 4 twice to the hero who acted last

mantle.name: Mantle
mantle.text: gains 4 Block, dodges the next hit

kings_hawk.lore: It was buried hooded on its block at the king's right hand, so he would not ride out alone. It is still waiting for the hood to come off.

sexton_beetles.name: Sexton Beetles

pour.name: Pour Over the Feet
pour.text: 3, 2 Toxin and 1 Lockdown to the front hero

bury.name: Bury
bury.text: 3 and 1 Toxin to the two front heroes

sexton_beetles.lore: They bury what they eat. In the barrow they never run short of either.

barrow_mason.name: Barrow Mason

wall.name: Wall Them In
wall.text: 4 and Stun to the front hero

barrow_mason.lore: He laid the last stone from the inside. He is still laying them.

rat_catcher.name: Rat-Catcher

pole.name: Rat Pole
pole.text: 5 and 2 Toxin to the front hero; puts Plague Fleas in their hand

rat_catcher.lore: He was paid by the tail. There is no one left to pay him, and he has not stopped.

barrow_thane.name: Barrow Thane

rot.name: Rotting Cut
rot.text: 7, 2 Weaken and 2 Toxin to the front hero

traits.name: Keeps Them in Line
traits.text: At round start his household is Anchored: no hero can move them.

barrow_thane.lore: A lord buried with his household. He still keeps them in line.

rot_witch.name: Rot Witch

salts.name: Plague Salts
salts.text: 3 Toxin and 2 Hex to the rearmost hero

curse.name: Wasting Curse
curse.text: 6 stress and 1 Volatile Toxin to every hero

nail.name: Frost Nail
nail.text: 9 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

embalm.name: Embalm
embalm.text: The most wounded foe: cleanses 4, 8 Block

traits.name: Embalmer
traits.text: At round start each of her allies sheds 1 ailment stack.

rot_witch.lore: She keeps the barrow's dead from rotting, and their plague from dying.

barrow_chaplain.name: Barrow Chaplain

rites.name: The Last Rites Again
rites.text: 14 stress to the most wounded hero

traits.name: Last Rites
traits.text: When a foe falls, he says the rites: every hero gains 5 stress.

barrow_chaplain.lore: He gave the last rites to everyone in the barrow. He is giving them again.

pest_house_watchman.name: Pest-House Watchman

nail.name: Nail Them In
nail.text: 5, Stun, Anchored and 1 Blight to the most wounded hero

padlock.name: Padlock and Chain
padlock.text: 8 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

traits.name: The Watch-Box
traits.text: At round start the oak box takes the first blows: he gains 10 Block.

pest_house_watchman.lore: He nailed the sick into their houses. Then someone nailed him into his watch-box.

barrow_king.name: The Barrow King

winter.name: The Long Winter
winter.text: 2 Weaken and 6 stress to every hero

sweep.name: Rotting Sweep
sweep.text: 9 and 2 Toxin to the two front heroes

plague.name: Plague of Kings
plague.text: 4, 2 Toxin and 1 Volatile Weaken to every hero

pour.name: The Plague Pours Out
pour.text: 2 Toxin and 4 stress to every hero

traits.name: Buboes Under the Frost
traits.text: While he carries Fire, every hit on him bursts a bubo: 1 Toxin on every hero.

phases.text: The King's court wakes in their graves.
The King's flesh splits. The plague pours out.

barrow_king.lore: He sealed his kingdom in the barrow to stop the plague. The plague was already inside.

rat_king.name: The Rat King

bury.name: Bury the Front
bury.text: 14 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

rot.name: Cold Plague
rot.text: 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Toxin to every hero

pour.name: The Living Pour Over
pour.text: 2 three times and 1 Bleed to every hero

traits.name: Always Hungry
traits.text: Whenever another foe falls, it eats: it heals 12.

traits.name: Flea-Ridden
traits.text: A hero who hits it gains 1 Toxin.

phases.text: The frozen dead rats fall away. The living pour out.
Only the knot of tails is left.

rat_king.lore: The barrow rats froze together at the tails. There is one of them now, and it is always hungry.

dead_cart.name: The Dead-Cart

seize.name: The Heap Reaches
seize.text: 6, Anchored and 2 Toxin to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 3

take.name: It No Longer Waits
take.text: 9, Anchored and 2 Toxin to the most wounded hero; drags them forward 3

spill.name: The Heap Spills
spill.text: 4, 2 Weaken and 1 Volatile Toxin to every hero

traits.name: Calling for the Dead
traits.text: Each foe that falls is taken onto the heap: the cart gains 8 Block.

phases.text: It no longer waits for them to finish dying.
The horse buckles. The heap spills.

dead_cart.lore: It went round the barrow calling for the dead. It no longer waits for them to finish dying.

scalded_attendant.name: Scalded Attendant

towel.name: Wet Towel
towel.text: 5 and 2 Soak to the front hero

hook.name: Towel Hook
hook.text: 4 and 1 Soak to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

scalded_attendant.lore: It still brings towels. Its skin comes away on them.

kettle_crab.name: Kettle Crab

traits.name: Steam Spout
traits.text: Every hit cracks the shell and it vents: the hero who hit it gains 1 Burn (up to 5 times a round).

kettle_crab.lore: Cooked alive in the pools and somehow still walking.

boiled_brute.name: Boiled Brute

dunk.name: Dunk
dunk.text: 5, 3 Soak and 6 stress to the front hero

boiled_brute.lore: A bath guard who stayed in the water too long. He is very soft now, and very strong.

steam_nymph.name: Steam Nymph

breath.name: Scalding Breath
breath.text: 5 and 2 Burn to the rearmost hero

steam_nymph.lore: It drifts over the pools and sings to the drowned.

drain.name: Drain

hook.text: 5 and 1 Burn to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

rake.name: Rake
rake.text: 7 and 1 Burn to the front hero

hypocaust_stoker.lore: He kept the fires under the floors. He has not come up for air in a hundred years.

votive_pilgrim.name: Votive Pilgrim

hop.name: Hop Aside
hop.text: gains 4 Block, dodges the next hit

votive_pilgrim.lore: She hung a clay leg at the spring and asked to walk again. She is walking.

physic_of_the_waters.name: Physic of the Waters

flask.name: Boiling Flask
flask.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Burn to a random hero

examine.name: Examine
examine.text: Mark and 1 Soak to the front hero

prescribe.name: Prescribe a Soak
prescribe.text: 4 Regen to the most wounded foe

physic_of_the_waters.lore: He prescribed the waters for every complaint. He takes them himself now, hourly.

lustral_priest.name: Lustral Priest

sprinkle.name: Boiling Sprinkle
sprinkle.text: 2, 1 Soak and 1 Volatile Burn to the two front heroes

lustral_priest.lore: He blesses every bather with the holy water. It is still holy, and it is boiling.

lapdog.name: Lapdog

bite.name: Ankle Bite
bite.text: 6 and 1 Bleed to the front hero

guard.name: Her Dog
guard.text: gains 6 Block, guards the weakest foe

lapdog.lore: It came in with a countess. It bites everyone but her.

hypocaust_roaches.name: Hypocaust Roaches

flood.name: Up the Legs
flood.text: 2 three times and 1 Burn to the front hero

hypocaust_roaches.lore: They lived in the warm under the floors. It is very warm now.

pump_mule.name: Pump Mule
pump_mule.lore: It turned the wheel that lifted the water. Nobody told it to stop.

bath_mistress.name: The Bath-Mistress

ladle.name: Ladleful
ladle.text: 4, 1 Soak and 1 Volatile Burn to the most burnt hero

bath_mistress.lore: She keeps the water hot and the guests clean.

cauldron_bearer.lore: It carries the boiling water from the furnace to the pools. It carries other things, too.

strigil_master.name: The Strigil-Master

rake.name: Raking Scrape
rake.text: 6 to the two front heroes; takes their Block

oil.text: gains 8 Block, dodges the next hit

strigil_master.lore: He scraped the nobility clean with a bronze blade. He has not stopped at the dirt.

invalid_countess.name: The Invalid Countess

ram.name: Ram the Pole

bottle.name: Bottle of Boiling Water

traits.text: Round start: the front bearer braces under the pole: gains 6 Block.

invalid_countess.lore: She was carried here to be cured. Her bearers were told not to put her down.

sweep.name: Sweep the Rim

She boils over.

simmering_matron.lore: The matron of the baths. She has been simmering for a hundred years and is nearly ready.

best_families.name: The Best Families

arms.name: A Dozen Arms
arms.text: 6, Anchored and 1 Soak to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

fall.name: A Bather Falls Out

steam.name: Steam of the Seventh Pool
steam.text: 2 Soak and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

traits.text: Every hero who hits the heap is complained at: 2 stress per hit (up to 5 times a round).

phases.text: The heap parts. Bathers fall out of it.
The patriarch rises on the heap, shouting.

best_families.lore: The seventh pool was kept for the best families. They have climbed out to complain about the water.

great_copper.name: The Great Copper

valve.name: The Valve Lifts
valve.text: 5, 1 Soak and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero; spends its Pressure

rake.name: Rake the Coals
rake.text: 10 and 2 Burn to the front hero

shovel.text: 6 and 1 Burn to the two front heroes

phases.text: The seams split and glow.
It bursts. Hot water weeps from every seam.

great_copper.lore: The boiler that heats every pool in the temple. Its stokers are still on shift.

wrecker.name: Wrecker

lamp.name: Wave the False Lamp
lamp.text: 7 stress to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

hook.name: Wrecking Hook
hook.text: 5 and 1 Soak to the hero in rank 2

wrecker.lore: It lights a lamp on the cliff and waits for the ships to come in.

shock_eel.name: Shock Eel

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.text: 4 and 2 Volatile Static to the most wounded hero; spends its Glow

traits.name: Live Flesh
traits.text: Whoever strikes it gains 1 Static.

shock_eel.lore: It lives in the shallows where the wrecks are. It is why there are no survivors.

storm_harpy.name: Storm Harpy

dive.name: Dive
dive.text: 6 and 1 Static to the rearmost hero

storm_harpy.lore: It rides the storm down onto the wrecks.

tide_crab.name: Tide Crab
tide_crab.lore: It picks the wrecks clean. You are a wreck.

drowned_bosun.name: Drowned Bosun

haul.name: Haul Away
haul.text: 4 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

drowned_bosun.lore: The wreckers' last catch. He signed on.

lantern_cow.name: Lantern Cow

light.name: Riding Light
light.text: guards the weakest foe, gains 6 Block

butt.name: Lumbering Butt
butt.text: 8 and 2 Static to the front hero

lantern_cow.lore: They tied a lamp to her horns and walked her slowly along the cliff. Ships took her for a harbour.

ship_breaker.name: Ship-Breaker

pry.name: Crowbar
pry.text: 4 to the front hero; takes their Block

strip.name: Strip the Hull
strip.text: 5 to the front hero; strips 1 Armor

ship_breaker.lore: He broke every wreck down to timber and nails. He does not stop at the wreck.

storm_petrels.name: Storm Petrels

pour.name: The Flock Pours Over
pour.text: 1 four times and 2 Static to the most wounded hero

patter.name: Patter on the Surf
patter.text: 2 three times and 1 Static to the rearmost hero

storm_petrels.lore: Sailors call them the storm's chickens and pray not to see them. On this coast, nobody has to wait.

rock_octopus.name: Rock Octopus

wrap.name: Copper Arm
wrap.text: 5, 2 Static and Anchored to the front hero

rock_octopus.lore: It walled its den with whatever the wrecks gave up. The lightning found the copper.

drowned_drummer.name: Drowned Drummer

roll.name: Beat to Quarters
roll.text: 6 stress and 1 Static to every hero

drowned_drummer.lore: He beat to quarters as she struck. He is beating still, and the crew still come.

cragsman.name: Cragsman

noose.name: Horsehair Noose
noose.text: 4 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

cragsman.lore: He went over the cliff on a rope for the harpies' eggs. Neither he nor the rope came back up.

drowned_merchant.name: Drowned Merchant

guard.name: Shield the Goods
guard.text: guards the weakest foe, gains 6 Block

ram.name: Ram with the Box
ram.text: 8 and 2 Static to the front hero

drowned_merchant.lore: He would not let go of the strongbox when she struck. The lightning saw to it that he never will.

lighthouse_keeper.name: The Lighthouse Keeper

beam.name: False Beam
beam.text: Mark and 1 Static to the hero holding the most cards; puts Lens Glare in their hand

flash.name: The Lens Flashes
flash.text: 10 and 1 Volatile Static to the Marked hero

fog.name: Sea Fog
fog.text: 2 Soak to every hero; strips their Ward

traits.name: Glare of the Lens
traits.text: Whoever strikes him is lit by the lens: Marked.

lighthouse_keeper.lore: He keeps the light burning in the wrong place.

harpy_matron.name: Harpy Matron

dive.name: Dive from the Storm
dive.text: 10 and 2 Static to the rearmost hero

traits.name: Brood Mother
traits.text: When a foe dies she gains 2 Might.

harpy_matron.lore: The mother of the storm harpies, crowned with a drowned queen's circlet.

gibbeted_wrecker.name: The Gibbeted Wrecker

creak.name: Creak in the Wind
creak.text: gains 12 Block, builds 2 Charge in the Irons

struck.name: The Gibbet Is Struck
struck.text: 5 and 2 Volatile Static to every hero; spends its Charge in the Irons

traits.name: Lightning Rod
traits.text: The highest metal for miles: Static laid on him charges the irons by 2; at 4 the strike jumps to every hero.

gibbeted_wrecker.lore: Hanged in irons on the headland as a warning to the coast. The irons are the highest metal for miles.

strand_wife.name: The Strand-Wife

rings.name: Ringed Fist
rings.text: 7 and 2 Static to the most armoured hero; takes their Block

hook.name: Boat Hook
hook.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

pockets.name: Go Through the Pockets
pockets.text: 5 to a random hero; strips their Might, gains 1 Might

traits.name: Salvage Sack
traits.text: When she dies her sack spills: every hero gains 5 Block.

strand_wife.lore: After every wreck she walked the tideline and took what the drowned no longer needed. Their rings will not come off.

thunder_whale.name: The Thunder Whale

spout.name: Spout
spout.text: 3 Soak to the hero in rank 3; shoves them back 1

song.name: Thunder Song
song.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

traits.name: Harpoon Rods
traits.text: Static laid on it runs into the harpoons and loads its next blow: Empower 4.

traits.name: Storm in the Ropes
traits.text: The storm runs back up the harpoons: whoever strikes it gains 1 Static.

phases.text: The harpoons light. It sings, and the storm answers.
It sounds, and rises blind in both eyes.

thunder_whale.lore: The storm on the coast is its song.

last_prize.name: The Last Prize

drag.name: Drag Aboard
drag.text: 6 and Anchored to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 3

surf.name: Surf Over the Rail
surf.text: 4 and 2 Soak to the two front heroes

traits.text: Each time she lists further the sea floods in: she gains 6 Soak (3 after her resistance), and the company's lightning finds her.

phases.text: She lists. The hold stoves in and the sea comes over the rail.
She is going down. The bell rings, and the drowned drag the living down with her.

last_prize.lore: The richest ship the coast ever took. It has been going down for a hundred years and has not finished.

wind_seller.name: The Wind-Seller

push.name: Offshore Gust
push.text: 4 and 2 Soak to the front hero; shoves them back 2

pull.name: Onshore Gust
pull.text: 3 and 2 Soak to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

bolt.name: A Bolt on the Rank
bolt.text: 9 and 2 Volatile Static to a random hero

storm.name: The Third Knot
storm.text: 5 and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

traits.name: Three Knots
traits.text: Each phase unties a knot on her cord, and her moves change with it.

phases.text: The second knot comes undone. A gale.
The third knot. The storm.

wind_seller.lore: She sold sailors their winds tied up in knotted cord. On this coast she only ever sold the one kind.

warden.name: Hollow Tidewarden

sweep.name: Halberd Sweep
sweep.text: 6 and 1 Volatile Soak to the two front heroes

hold.name: Hold the Door
hold.text: gains 12 Block, guards the weakest foe

traits.name: Lodger
traits.text: Round start: the pale thing in its chest tastes the water and gives the front hero 1 Erode.

warden.lore: A temple guard grown into the sea. Something lives in the hole in its chest.

abbess.name: Abbess of Salt

sermon.name: Silent Sermon
sermon.text: 6 stress and 1 Soak to every hero

salt.name: Salt the Wound
salt.text: 11 and Vulnerable to the front hero

rites.name: Last Rites
rites.text: The most wounded foe: heals 16, cleanses 3

seal.name: Seal the Door
seal.text: 4 stress to the hero holding the most cards; puts Sewn Shut in their hand

traits.name: Salt Crust
traits.text: Round start: if she has no Ward, she gains 2 Ward, so the first course stacks on her are cancelled.

abbess.lore: Her mouth is sewn shut. She preaches anyway.

kraken_arm.name: The Grasping Deep

grab.name: Grab
grab.text: 6, Anchored and 1 Soak to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 3

breach.name: Into the Breach
breach.text: 6 and 1 Volatile Erode to the front hero

traits.name: Held Fast
traits.text: A hero who lands a hit on the arm is no longer Anchored.

kraken_arm.lore: Only one arm reaches up through the floor. Pray it is only one.

pearl_diver.name: Pearl Diver

knife.name: Shucking Knife
knife.text: 6 twice and 5 (if the target has no Block) to the rearmost hero

leap.name: Leap the Line
leap.text: 10 and 2 Bleed to the hero in rank 3

weight.name: Stone Weight
weight.text: 4 and 2 Soak to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

sink.name: Sink from Sight
sink.text: gains 8 Block, dodges the next hit

traits.name: Nacre Crust
traits.text: When hit, its pearl crust hardens: it gains 3 Block.

pearl_diver.lore: It goes for the soft ones at the back. It always has.

thrall.name: Drowned Thrall

hook.name: Boat Hook
hook.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

soak.name: Waterlogged
soak.text: 4 and 2 Soak to the front hero

thrall.lore: Sailors who went down with the fleet. They still haul at anything that floats.

siren.name: Brine Siren

lure.name: Lure
lure.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Erode to the rearmost hero

spray.name: Brine Spray
spray.text: 3 and 1 Soak to the two front heroes

siren.lore: Its song is the last thing the drowned remember. It wants you to remember it too.

eelkin.name: Eel-kin Biter

bite.name: Latching Bite
bite.text: 4 and 3 Bleed to the front hero

slither.name: Slither
slither.text: gains 6 Block, dodges the next hit

traits.name: Latched
traits.text: A hero who hits the Biter shakes it off: that hero's Bleed ends.

eelkin.lore: They feed by latching on and not letting go.

bellringer.name: Drowned Bell-Ringer

traits.name: Knell
traits.text: On death it rings once more: every hero gains 4 stress.

bellringer.lore: The bell is rung for the dead. Down here, that is everyone.

barnacle_knight.name: Barnacle Knight

encrust.name: Encrust
encrust.text: gains 10 Block, guards the weakest foe

bash.name: Shield Bash
bash.text: 6 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

traits.name: Oathbound
traits.text: When an ally falls, it gains 8 Block.

barnacle_knight.lore: Oathbound to a drowned order. The sea has kept his armour on for him.

lamprey.name: Lamprey Swarm

latch.name: Latch
latch.text: 3 and 2 Bleed to the front hero; heals itself

feed.name: Feeding Knot
feed.text: 2 three times to a random hero

lamprey.lore: A knot of mouths. Where one is, the rest follow.

bloated.name: Bloated Corpse

ooze.name: Ooze
ooze.text: 2 Soak to the two front heroes

traits.name: Burst
traits.text: On death, foul water spills: every hero gains 2 Soak.

bloated.lore: Gas swells the dead until the skin will not hold. Do not be close when it fails.

hookline.name: Hookline Fisher

reel.name: Reel In
reel.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

net.name: Cast Net
net.text: Anchored and 3 stress to every hero

hookline.lore: Still fishing. The catch has changed.

weeping_nun.name: Weeping Nun

tears.name: Salt Tears
tears.text: 2 Soak to the most wounded foe; heals 12

kiss.name: Brine Kiss
kiss.text: 6 and 1 Soak to the front hero

weeping_nun.lore: She weeps for the drowned. Her tears close their wounds.

anchor_brute.name: Anchor Brute

swing.name: Anchor Swing
swing.text: 11 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

drag.name: Drag to the Front
drag.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 3

anchor_brute.lore: The anchor chain runs through his arm. He has stopped noticing.

choirboy.name: Drowned Choirboy

note.name: Void Note
note.text: 1 Erode and 3 stress to the rearmost hero

choirboy.lore: He has been singing since the water came in. He does not need to breathe to sing.

drowned_king.name: The Drowned King

crown.name: Crown of Tides
crown.text: 2 Soak and 4 stress to every hero

decree.name: Drown the Court
decree.text: 1 Volatile Erode and 3 stress to every hero

gorge.name: Gorge on the Court
gorge.text: heals 8, heals 14 (at 2+ foes standing), heals 14 (at 3+ foes standing), gains 1 Might (at 2+ foes standing)

traits.name: Kept Court
traits.text: Round start: if fewer than three of his court stand, he calls a Barnacle Knight into the front rank (once a fight).

phases.text: The King rises from the throne.
The King gorges on his court.

drowned_king.lore: He kept his crown. The sea grew it into him.

bell_below.name: The Bell Below

toll.name: Toll
toll.text: 6 stress and 1 Soak to every hero; spends its Toll

reach.name: Reaching Dead
reach.text: 9 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

knell.name: Knell
knell.text: 1 Volatile Erode and 3 stress to every hero

clapper.name: The Clapper Wakes
clapper.text: 8 twice to the two front heroes

traits.name: Struck Bronze
traits.text: Every hit on the bell rings: every hero gains 1 stress (up to 5 times a round).

traits.name: Count of the Drowned
traits.text: Round start: the Toll rises by 1. At 3 it tolls.

phases.text: The bell cracks. The ringer bound to its clapper wakes.
The chain groans. The bell swings low over the company.

bell_below.lore: Rung once for every soul that drowned. It has not stopped ringing.

mother_of_brine.name: Mother of Brine

lullaby.name: Lullaby
lullaby.text: 6 stress and 1 Soak to every hero

embrace.name: Embrace
embrace.text: 13 and Anchored to the front hero; heals itself

chorus.name: Cradle Song
chorus.text: 1 Volatile Erode and 3 stress to every hero

eat.name: Eat Her Own
eat.text: heals 10, heals 14 (at 2+ foes standing), heals 14 (at 3+ foes standing)

traits.name: Mother's Grief
traits.text: When one of her daughters dies, every hero gains 5 stress.

phases.text: The lullaby turns to a scream.
She devours her own.

mother_of_brine.lore: Every siren is her daughter. Every drowned child is hers.

frozen_whaler.name: Frozen Whaler

harpoon.name: Harpoon on a Line
harpoon.text: 7 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

flense.name: Flensing Knife
flense.text: 8 and 2 Bleed to the front hero

frozen_whaler.lore: It still hunts whales. Anything large and slow will do.

rime_gulls.name: Rime Gulls

peck.name: Peck the Eyes
peck.text: 2 three times to the rearmost hero

mob.name: Mob
mob.text: 7 stress and Vulnerable to the rearmost hero

rime_gulls.lore: They followed the fleet out and froze with it. They thawed first.

ice_eel.name: Ice Eel

strike.name: Strike from the Hole
strike.text: 6 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.text: 4 and 2 Soak to the front hero

ice_eel.lore: It hunts through holes in the ice.

deck_hand.name: Drowned Deckhand
deck_hand.lore: Still ready to board. Still singing.

walrus_brute.name: Walrus Brute

blubber.name: Wall of Blubber
blubber.text: gains 10 Block, keeps its Block, guards the weakest foe

crush.name: Belly Crush
crush.text: 6 and Stun to the front hero

walrus_brute.lore: It hauled out on the ice beside the ships and never left.

powder_monkey.name: Powder Monkey

spare.name: A Spare Cartridge
spare.text: 3 Empower to the most wounded foe; 4 Block

duck.name: Duck Behind the Guns
duck.text: gains 6 Block, dodges the next hit

powder_monkey.lore: He was sent below for powder as the sea froze. He is still bringing it.

sea_lice.name: Sea Lice

strip.name: Strip to the Bone
strip.text: 4 and 3 Bleed to the front hero

surge.name: Surge Over the Legs
surge.text: 3 and 1 Bleed to the two front heroes

traits.name: The Lice Scatter
traits.text: When the heap dies, the lice scatter over the two front heroes: 3 Bleed each.

sea_lice.lore: Sailors are sewn into their hammocks for burial. The lice do not mind the stitching.

capstan_gang.name: Capstan Gang

heave.name: Heave Round
heave.text: 4 to the two front heroes; gains 1 Might

walk.name: Walk the Drum Forward
walk.text: 8 to the front hero; gains 1 Might

traits.name: Lose the Count
traits.text: When it is Stunned or Frozen, the fiddler loses the time: it loses all its Might.

capstan_gang.lore: They were weighing anchor when the sea froze. They have not stopped pushing.

sailmaker.name: The Sailmaker

needle.name: Stitch in Place
needle.text: 5 and Stun to the front hero

sailmaker.lore: He sews the dead into their hammocks. The last stitch goes through the nose, to be sure.

fleet_marine.name: Fleet Marine

order.name: Close Order
order.text: The most wounded foe: guards an ally, gains 6 Block

traits.name: Order Kept
traits.text: A hero who moved this round and then strikes him meets the bayonet: it takes 3.

fleet_marine.lore: He was posted to keep order on deck. Order has been kept.

galley_cook.name: The Galley Cook

ladle.name: Ladle Out
ladle.text: A random hero: puts Ship's Broth in their hand

galley_cook.lore: The stores ran out in the second month. The pot did not.

ice_edge_orca.name: Ice-Edge Orca

drag.name: Slide and Bite
drag.text: 7 and 2 Soak to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

ice_edge_orca.lore: It learned to slide onto the ice for seals. Sailors stand closer to the edge.

icewed_captain.name: The Ice-Wed Captain

sabre.name: Icicle Sabre
sabre.text: 12 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

keelhaul.name: Keelhaul
keelhaul.text: 8 and 2 Soak to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

belay.name: Belay That
belay.text: 6 to the front hero; takes their Block

traits.name: Command
traits.text: At round start the allies beside him keep their Block this round.

icewed_captain.lore: Married to the sea, and the sea froze at the wedding.

frost_selkie.name: Frost Selkie

lunge.name: Lunge and Bite
lunge.text: 9 and 2 Bleed to the front hero

louder.name: Sing Louder
louder.text: 4 and 14 stress to the most stressed hero

traits.name: Stolen Skin
traits.text: At round start she gains 6 Block: the first blow glances off the stolen skin.

frost_selkie.lore: She lost her skin to a sailor. She took his in return.

white_bear.name: The White Bear

paw.name: Forepaw
paw.text: 15 and Anchored to the front hero

traits.name: Climbed Out Anyway
traits.text: When it is Stunned or Frozen, it climbs out angrier: it gains 2 Might.

white_bear.lore: It crossed the ice to eat the frozen crews. It fell through where the ice was thin, and climbed out anyway.

ships_surgeon.name: The Ship's Surgeon

saw.name: Bow Saw
saw.text: 9, 3 Bleed and 1 Volatile Weaken to the front hero

tourniquet.name: Screw Tourniquet
tourniquet.text: The most wounded foe: heals 14, 6 Block

douse.name: Spirit on the Wound
douse.text: 2 Soak to the two front heroes

amputate.name: Take the Arm
amputate.text: 14 and 6 stress to the most wounded hero

traits.name: Save the Rest
traits.text: When an ally falls, he heals the most wounded ally 12.

ships_surgeon.lore: He took the frozen fingers to save the hand, and the hand to save the arm. He has not finished saving anyone.

leviathan_ice.name: The Leviathan in the Ice

breath.name: White Breath
breath.text: 2 Soak and 1 Weaken to every hero

jaw.name: The Jaw Breaks Through
jaw.text: 15 and 2 Volatile Weaken to the Marked hero

swallow.name: Swallow Whole
swallow.text: 22 and 10 stress to the Marked hero

freeze.name: The Sea Freezes
freeze.text: 5, 1 Soak and 2 Volatile Weaken to every hero; spends its Breath

traits.name: The Eye Follows
traits.text: A hero who hits it is Marked: the eye under the ice follows them, and its single blows go there.

phases.text: The ice cracks. The Leviathan rises out of the sea.
It drags the whole fleet down with it.

leviathan_ice.lore: The fleet sailed to kill it. It froze the sea around them all.

the_broadside.name: The Broadside

full.name: Full Broadside
full.text: 6 and 2 Volatile Weaken to every hero; 3 to the two front heroes; spends its Load

port.name: Port Battery
port.text: 9 and 2 Soak to the two front heroes

swivel.name: Swivel Gun
swivel.text: 10 and Vulnerable to the rearmost hero

ripple.name: Every Gun at Once
ripple.text: 4 and 1 Weaken to every hero; 2 to the two front heroes; 2 to the front hero; loses 8 HP

traits.name: Boarders on the Ladder
traits.text: At round start, a frozen boarder drops from the entry ladder into an empty rank (twice per fight).

phases.text: Every gun at once. The ice in her barrels bursts them.
Her seams split along the waterline. The gunners keep firing.

the_broadside.lore: She fired the first broadside of the battle. The ice has kept her loaded ever since.

the_shrouds.name: The Shrouds

icicles.name: Icicles Fall
icicles.text: 3 three times and 2 Weaken to a random hero

sight.name: Sail Ho
sight.text: Vulnerable and 5 stress to the rearmost hero

traits.name: The Web Shudders
traits.text: Each time it enters a phase, icicles fall: 1 Frost on every hero.

phases.text: The lowest topmen let go for good.
The web parts. The rigging comes down.

the_shrouds.lore: The topmen were aloft when the sea froze. No one has called them down.

slag_slave.name: Slag Slave

slag.name: Throw Slag
slag.text: 4 and 2 Burn to the rearmost hero

slag_slave.lore: Chained at the neck to the anvil line. The cage on its head is for its own protection, they say.

bronze_automaton.name: Bronze Automaton

traits.name: Clockwork
traits.text: Its key turns down a notch each round; at the last notch it stops for a round unless it is wound.

bronze_automaton.lore: Wound by hand, powered by storm. It does not tire, and it does not stop.

arc_smith.name: Arc-Smith

strike.name: Charged Strike
strike.text: 6 and 2 Static to the front hero

weld.name: Arc Weld
weld.text: 5 and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero

arc_smith.lore: It welds with its hammer. It welds with you, too.

bellows_imp.name: Bellows Imp

fan.name: Fan the Flames
fan.text: 1 Burn (if the target has Burn) to every hero

bellows_imp.lore: Small, winged and full of hot air. They keep the forges breathing.

spark_swarm.name: Spark Swarm

sting.name: Stinging Sparks
sting.text: 2 three times and 1 Static to the front hero

burst.name: Burst of Sparks
burst.text: 2, 1 Static and 1 Burn to a random hero

spark_swarm.lore: Struck from the anvil and never cooled.

salamander.name: Salamander

bite.name: Darting Bite
bite.text: 7 and 1 Burn to the front hero

flare.name: Blotches Flare
flare.text: 3 and 3 Burn to the front hero

dart.name: Dart Aside
dart.text: dodges the next hit, gains 4 Block

salamander.lore: The smiths swore it lived in the fire. Now it does.

mould_sitter.name: Mould-Sitter

blow.name: Stiff-Armed Blow
blow.text: 8 and 1 Burn to the front hero

drip.name: Bronze Drips
drip.text: 3 and 1 Burn to the two front heroes

traits.name: Clay Mould
traits.text: Every hit cracks a piece of the mould away: it loses 1 Armor.

mould_sitter.lore: He sat for the guild's statue of a working man. The guild was short of time, and cast from life.

coke_heaver.name: Coke-Heaver

shovel.name: Shovel of Coke
shovel.text: 5 and 1 Burn to the two front heroes

coke_heaver.lore: He fed the furnaces one basket at a time. The furnaces are still hungry.

nail_wife.name: Nail-Wife

nails.name: Nails Break Off
nails.text: 4 and 3 Bleed to the front hero

traits.name: Bristling
traits.text: The nails bite back: whoever strikes her takes 2.

nail_wife.lore: She made nails by the thousand at her little hearth. When the storm came through, they all came back to her.

guild_warden.name: Guild Warden

mark.name: Guild Mark
mark.text: 4, Mark and 2 Burn to a random hero

fine.name: Fine
fine.text: 9 stress to the most stressed hero

guild_warden.lore: He kept the guild's true measure and fined anyone short of it. He has fined the storm twice.

automaton_tender.name: Automaton Tender

wind.name: Wind the Machine
wind.text: 2 Might to the front foe; spends its charge

automaton_tender.lore: She wound the automata every morning and oiled them every night. They have stopped needing either, and she has not noticed.

hearth_cat.name: Hearth Cat

scratch.name: Discharging Scratch
scratch.text: 4 and 2 Static to the front hero

traits.name: Static Coat
traits.text: Whoever strikes it gains 1 Static.

hearth_cat.lore: It slept on the warm anvil every night. Every night is warm now.

cyclops_smith.name: The Sparkblind Smith

brand.name: Brand
brand.text: 9, 2 Burn and Mark to the busiest hero

traits.name: By Ear
traits.text: He hears whoever strikes him: the attacker is Marked, and his hammer follows the Mark.

cyclops_smith.lore: The master smith watched the fire until the sparks took his eyes. He works by the ring of the iron now.

talos_sentinel.name: Talos Sentinel

thrust.name: Spear Thrust
thrust.text: 12 and Anchored to the front hero

ichor.name: Ichor Spray
ichor.text: 6 and 3 Burn to the rearmost hero

traits.name: One Vein
traits.text: A single nail plugs the heel: at round start it loses HP equal to its Bleed, so Bleed hurts it twice.

talos_sentinel.lore: A guardian of hollow bronze, filled with molten ichor. One vein in the heel holds it all.

wire_drawer.name: The Wire-Drawer

whip2.name: Live Wire
whip2.text: 7, Anchored and 2 Static to the hero in rank 2; drags them forward 1

whip3.name: Longer Wire
whip3.text: 7, Anchored and 2 Static to the hero in rank 3; drags them forward 1

whip4.name: Wire to the Back
whip4.text: 8, Anchored and 2 Static to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

traits.name: Draw-Plate
traits.text: He draws a fresh length each round: his wire reaches one rank further (rank 2, then 3, then the back).

wire_drawer.lore: He drew bronze into wire for the automata. The storm runs down every inch he ever made.

dray_horse.name: The Dray Horse

rear.name: Rear and Crash
rear.text: 14 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

sparks.name: Sparks Across the Rank
sparks.text: 4, 1 Static and 1 Burn to the two front heroes

traits.name: Storm-Shod
traits.text: It stamps and sparks: the front hero gains 1 Static each round.

dray_horse.lore: It hauled the bells out of the pits on a sledge. The storm shod it, and it will not be unshod.

anvil_titan.name: The Anvil Titan

tap.name: Tap the Anvil
tap.text: 9, 1 Static and Mark to the front hero

blow.name: The Full Blow
blow.text: 14 through Block, 2 Static and 1 Volatile Burn to the Marked hero; spends its Rhythm

furnace.name: Plasma Furnace
furnace.text: 3, 1 Static and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

rivet.name: Rivet
rivet.text: 10 and Anchored to the rearmost hero

plasma.name: Every Blow Is Plasma
plasma.text: 12 through Block, 1 Static and 1 Volatile Burn to the Marked hero

traits.name: Rhythm
traits.text: It taps on a count of three, Marking the hero it strikes; the third beat is the full blow on the Marked hero, Plasma through Block. A Taunt or Guard turns it.

phases.text: The core splits and lightning spills from the seams.
It leaves the anvil. There is no count now, and every blow is Plasma.

anvil_titan.lore: The foundry's first work. Its makers built it to strike the anvil forever. It found something softer.

crucible.name: The Crucible

wave.name: Wave of Bronze
wave.text: 7 and 2 Burn to the two front heroes

plasma.name: Sparks Down the Stream
plasma.text: 5, 2 Burn and 1 Volatile Static to the two front heroes

bell.name: The Bell Rings
bell.text: 3 and 9 stress to every hero; spends its Bell Count

traits.name: The Pour
traits.text: Bronze runs into the bell pit each round; at 6 the bell rings. Frost or Soak on the Crucible stops that round's pour.

phases.text: It tips further. The wave reaches deeper, and the fused chains spark.
The bell is cast. The half-cast bell in the pit rings every round.

crucible.lore: It was tipped to pour the great bell when the storm struck. It has been pouring ever since, and the bell is not finished.

storm_catcher.name: The Storm-Catcher

fern.name: Fern the Skin
fern.text: Mark and 2 Static to a random hero

heave.name: Heave on the Cables
heave.text: 3, 6 (if Marked) and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

spark.name: Spark Down the Cable
spark.text: 10 and 1 Burn to the rearmost hero

ferns.name: The Cables Sing
ferns.text: Mark and 2 Static to the two rear heroes

let_go.name: He Lets Go
let_go.text: 6, 1 Static and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

traits.name: Sparks in the Fists
traits.text: Below about half HP, whoever strikes him gains 1 Static.

phases.text: The cables sing. He marks two heroes a round, and sparks run down into his fists.
He lets go of one cable. It whips across every rank, and the storm strikes every mark at once.

storm_catcher.lore: He built the spire that caught the storm for the forges. He is still holding on to it.

root_horror.name: Root Horror

grasp.name: Root Grasp
grasp.text: 5 and Anchored to the rearmost hero

root_horror.lore: The garden's roots grew a mouth.

antlered_mother.name: The Antlered Mother

bloom.name: Blight Bloom
bloom.text: 3, 1 Toxin and 1 Erode to every hero

exhale.name: Spore Exhalation
exhale.text: 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Erode to every hero

rot.name: The Fungus Blooms
rot.text: 4, 1 Toxin, 1 Volatile Erode and 2 Erode to every hero

traits.name: The Garden's Heart
traits.text: Round start: above a fifth of her HP she regrows 8, unless she is Blighted or Burning.

phases.text: All her eyes open.
The fungus takes her whole. She stops healing herself.

antlered_mother.lore: The garden's heart: a great stag grown through with fungus and eyes. She is the garden now.

flower_strewer.name: Flower-Strewer

petals.name: Strew Petals
petals.text: 4 Regen to the most wounded foe

fling.name: A Flung Handful
fling.text: 3, 1 Toxin and 1 Erode to a random hero

flower_strewer.lore: She strewed petals for the lady to walk on. The lady has not walked in a long time.

lady_of_the_bower.name: The Lady of the Bower

sigh.name: A Sigh of Pollen
sigh.text: 1 Toxin, 1 Erode and 4 stress to every hero

sleep.name: The Sleeping Spore
sleep.text: Stun to the two rear heroes

traits.name: The Bed Blooms
traits.text: Round start: a bloom opens on the bed unless she is Burning; fire burns every open bloom away. Her Regen becomes 1 per open bloom.

phases.text: She rises on her elbow. Spring keeps coming.
She sits up in the bower, wide awake.

lady_of_the_bower.lore: She lay down in her bower to wait for spring. It came, and it has not stopped coming.

green_lion.name: The Green Lion

double.name: Swipe and Swipe Again
double.text: 6 twice to the two front heroes

roar.name: Spore Roar
roar.text: 3, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Erode to every hero

traits.name: Grown Back
traits.text: Round start: it regains 10 HP unless it is Burning.

phases.text: Clipped through. The holes widen and the shears in its flank show.
The rot takes the frame. It stops pretending to be a hedge.

green_lion.lore: Clipped into a lion for her pleasure. The rot gave it a mind. It has kept the shape, and grown the teeth.

fungal_husk.name: Fungal Husk

cough.name: Spore Cough
cough.text: 4 and 2 Toxin to the hero in rank 2

traits.name: Bursts
traits.text: On death: it bursts; every hero gains 1 Toxin.

fungal_husk.lore: A gardener the mushrooms grew into.

the_gardener.name: The Gardener

shear.name: Pruning Shears
shear.text: 11 to the front hero; takes their Block

sow.name: Sow Blight
sow.text: 1 Toxin and 1 Erode to every hero

deadhead.name: Deadhead
deadhead.text: 9 and Vulnerable to the rearmost hero

traits.name: Sprout
traits.text: When an ally falls, its rank sprouts a Fungal Husk (once a fight).

the_gardener.lore: He keeps the garden. He prunes what grows wrong. You are growing wrong.

blight_dryad.name: Blight Dryad

roots.name: Roots Burst
roots.text: 6, Anchored and 2 Toxin to the rearmost hero

heart.name: Hollow Heartwood
heart.text: 5, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Erode to the most wounded hero

traits.name: Dead Oak
traits.text: Round start: below half HP she gains 3 Regen, unless she is Blighted or Burning.

blight_dryad.lore: She was the spirit of an oak. The oak is dead. She is not.

ladys_fool.name: The Lady's Fool

slap.name: Bauble Slap
slap.text: 6 to a random hero; puts Fool's Spore in their hand

jig.name: Puffball Jig
jig.text: 1 Toxin and 5 stress to every hero

caper.name: Cartwheel Away
caper.text: gains 8 Block, dodges the next hit

traits.name: Puffball Bells
traits.text: A hero who strikes him gains 1 Toxin.

ladys_fool.lore: She kept him to make her laugh. The rot thinks he is very funny.

truffle_boar.name: The Truffle Boar

charge.name: Tusking Charge
charge.text: 12 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

plough.name: Snout Plough
plough.text: 10 through Block to the front hero

traits.name: Fungal Crest
traits.text: A hero who strikes it gains 1 Toxin.

truffle_boar.lore: It was kept to find the truffles. It found all of them. It ate all of them.

spore_deer.name: Spore Deer

shake.name: Shake the Spores
shake.text: 1 Toxin and 4 stress to every hero

bolt.name: Bolt
bolt.text: gains 6 Block, dodges the next hit

spore_deer.lore: The fungus grows from its antlers. It is not the deer making the decisions now.

thorn_knight.name: Thorn Knight

blade.name: Thorn Blade
blade.text: 8 and 2 Bleed to the front hero

traits.name: Briars
traits.text: A hero who strikes it takes 2 from the briars, every hit.

thorn_knight.lore: Sworn to guard the garden. The garden grew through his armour.

moth_witch.name: Moth Witch
moth_witch.lore: The eyes on her wings are real. They blink.

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.lore: It was put up to frighten the birds. The rot put something in the straw.

blight_snails.name: Blight Snails

slide.name: Slide Over
slide.text: 3, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Erode to the most wounded hero

trail.name: Slime Trail
trail.text: 1 Toxin and 1 Erode to the two front heroes

traits.name: Shells
traits.text: Round start: it gains 5 Block; the first blow each round glances off a shell.

blight_snails.lore: Slow. Very slow. They have all the time the garden has.

mole_catcher.name: Mole-Catcher

stab.name: Spade Stab
stab.text: 6 and Vulnerable to the front hero; shoves them back 1

trap.name: Mole Trap
trap.text: 5 and Anchored to the hero in rank 2

mole_catcher.lore: He was paid a penny a mole. The moles have stopped dying.

pond_swan.name: Pond Swan

lunge.name: Lunge and Beat
lunge.text: 7 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

pond_swan.lore: The swans were the lady's. They still bite anyone who is not.

orchard_picker.name: Orchard Picker

fruit.name: Rotten Fruit
fruit.text: 4 and 1 Toxin to the two front heroes

pole.name: Picking Hook
pole.text: 7 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

orchard_picker.lore: The fruit is ripe. It has been ripe for a very long time.

beekeeper.name: Beekeeper

skep.name: Thump the Skep
skep.text: 2 Toxin and 1 Erode to a random hero

smoke.name: Smoking Torch
smoke.text: 1 Dodge to the most wounded foe

beekeeper.lore: The bees are gone. The skep is still full.

sting.name: Cloud of Stings
sting.text: 2 three times and 1 Toxin to the front hero

venom_spider.name: Venom Spider

bite.name: Drop and Bite
bite.text: 5 and 3 Toxin to a random hero

web.name: Web the Rear
web.text: 3 and Anchored to the rearmost hero

jolt.name: Paralysing Bite
jolt.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Static to the rearmost hero

traits.name: On Its Thread
traits.text: Struck by a hero who moved this round, it drops onto them: they gain 2 Toxin.

venom_spider.lore: It weaves between the spires and waits for the lightning to bring it food.

puppet_host.name: Puppet Host

spores.name: Spores
spores.text: 1 Toxin and 4 stress to every hero

lurch.name: Larval Lurch
lurch.text: 5 and 2 Toxin to the hero in rank 2

traits.name: The Larvae Burst Out
traits.text: On death: the two front heroes gain 2 Toxin.

puppet_host.lore: A traveller the hive has hollowed out and filled with larvae. It moves when they do.

galvanic_beetle.name: Galvanic Beetle

ram.name: Charged Horn
ram.text: 7 and 2 Static to the front hero

release.name: Release the Charge
release.text: 11 and 1 Volatile Static to the front hero; spends its Stored Lightning

traits.name: Stores the Strike
traits.text: Lightning laid on it is stored in its shell; at 3 its horn releases it as a Volatile jolt.

galvanic_beetle.lore: It stores lightning in its shell.

hive_drone.name: Hive Drone

dust.name: Venom Dust
dust.text: 3 and 2 Toxin to the rearmost hero

hive_drone.lore: It feeds the hive. Everything feeds the hive.

dowser.name: The Dowser

dip.name: The Rod Dips
dip.text: 4 stress to the most stressed hero; builds 1 The Rod Dips

snap.name: The Ground Splits
snap.text: 6, 2 Toxin and 6 stress to the most stressed hero; spends its The Rod Dips

traits.name: The Fork Still Pulls
traits.text: Struck by a hero after a flask was drunk this round, the rod turns to the water: that hero gains 4 stress.

dowser.lore: He walked the plain with a hazel fork and told each village where to dig its well. The fork still pulls.

struck_shepherd.name: Struck Shepherd

hook.name: Crook Hook
hook.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

sling.name: Sling Stone
sling.text: 6 and 1 Static to a random hero

struck_shepherd.lore: The storm killed the flock on the open plain. He herds whatever the hive sends instead.

highwayman.name: Highwayman

bolt.name: Crossbow Bolt
bolt.text: 7 and 4 (if the target has Neuro) to the rearmost hero

twitch.name: Twitching Trigger
twitch.text: 5 twice to the most wounded hero

traits.name: Smells the Purse
traits.text: Round start: if a hero is at Death's Door, he gains 2 Might (once).

highwayman.lore: He robbed travellers on the plain road. The hive takes a bigger share.

tinker.name: The Tinker

swing.name: Swing the Load
swing.text: 6 and Stun to the front hero

traits.name: Wasps in the Kettles
traits.text: Each hero who hits him gains 1 Toxin.

tinker.lore: He carried every pot on the road on his back. The lightning welded them to him.

road_warden.name: Road-Warden

attention.name: Stand to Attention
attention.text: gains 8 Block, guards the weakest foe

shackle.name: Shackles
shackle.text: 4 and Anchored to the front hero

road_warden.lore: He patrolled the plain road with a twelve-foot pike. For miles, he was the tallest thing.

spire_termites.name: Spire Termites

spray.name: Venom Spray
spray.text: 3 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

build.name: Build Round the Still
build.text: Stun (unless moved) and 3 stress to a random hero

spire_termites.lore: They build a spire around anything iron. Stand still long enough and they will build one around you.

antlion.name: Antlion

pit.name: Into the Glass Pit
pit.text: 3, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Static to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

antlion.lore: The lightning turned its pit to glass. Nothing climbs out of glass.

mantis_duelist.name: Mantis Duelist

scythe.name: Double Scythe
scythe.text: 6 twice to the hero who led the last Ordo

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.text: 9 and 2 Toxin to the rearmost hero

paralyse.name: Paralysing Strike
paralyse.text: 6, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Static to the hero who led the last Ordo

traits.name: Salute
traits.text: Round start: it bows and gains 2 Riposte while it has fewer than 4, so many small cuts feed its replies.

mantis_duelist.lore: It bows before every duel. It eats the loser.

brood_mother.name: Brood Mother

bite.name: Brood Bite
bite.text: 10 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

web.name: Web the Rear
web.text: 4, Anchored and 6 stress to the rearmost hero

hatch.name: Hatch
hatch.text: 1 Might and 3 Regen to every foe

traits.name: The Brood Scatters
traits.text: On death: up to two Venom Spiders join the fight if ranks are free.

brood_mother.lore: The spiders' queen. Her back crawls with young.

courier.name: The Courier

crop.name: Riding Crop
crop.text: 10 and 1 Toxin to the rearmost hero

spasm.name: Spasm
spasm.text: 6 and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

traits.name: Spasm
traits.text: When it is Stunned or loses an action, horse and rider lash out: the two front heroes take 6.

courier.lore: The storm caught him in the open with a message. The hive has rewritten it.

road_centipede.name: Road Centipede

claws.name: Venom Claws
claws.text: 9 and 2 Toxin to a random hero

strike.name: Downward Strike
strike.text: 8 and Stun to the rearmost hero

traits.name: Fused Segments
traits.text: Round start: if it has less than 4 Armor, the strike-welded middle restores 1.

road_centipede.lore: It lies across the road at night. Carters take it for a fallen beam.

hive_queen.name: The Hive Queen

sting.name: Royal Sting
sting.text: 14 and 3 Toxin to the front hero

neuro.name: The Colony Stings
neuro.text: 5, 2 Toxin and 2 Volatile Static to every hero

rod.name: The Rod Draws the Strike
rod.text: 4 and 2 Volatile Static to every hero

traits.name: Royal Guard
traits.text: Round start: while any other foe stands, her wasps close round her: she gains 8 Block.

traits.name: The Rod
traits.text: Each hero who strikes her while carrying Toxin gains 1 Volatile Lightning.

phases.text: She takes wing. She lays no more eggs, and her swarm comes for the rear.
The rod in her back draws the spire's strike. Every hero carrying Toxin locks.

hive_queen.lore: The heart of the spires. Every sting on the plain is hers.

procession.name: The Procession

tip.name: The Saint Tips
tip.text: 16 and Stun to the front hero

comb.name: The Comb Spills
comb.text: 2 Volatile Toxin to the two front heroes

pour.name: The Comb Pours
pour.text: 2 Volatile Toxin and 4 stress to every hero

traits.name: Twelve Backs
traits.text: It cannot be moved or Stunned. Each time a bearer falls (each new phase), comb spills: every hero gains 2 Toxin.

phases.text: The bearers falter. The float lists, and the saint swings across two ranks.
The saint falls, and the comb pours out over the last bearers.

procession.lore: The pilgrims were carrying their saint to the shrine when the storm broke. The hive carries all of them now.

cicada_under_the_road.name: The Cicada Under the Road

heave.name: The Paving Heaves
heave.text: 7 and 1 Static to the two front heroes

song.name: The Song
song.text: 6 stress, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Static to every hero; spends its Hum

beak.name: Venom Beak
beak.text: 12 and 2 Toxin to a random hero

shrill.name: The Shrill
shrill.text: 8 and Stun to a random hero

traits.name: The Hum
traits.text: Round start: the hum rises 1; every hero gains 2 stress per step of the hum (max 6). The shell's creak and the Song reset it.

phases.text: Its back splits along the lightning scar, and the pale adult pushes out. The shell's Armor is gone.
The wings unfurl. It sings every other turn, and the road stones jump.

cicada_under_the_road.lore: It went underground the year the lightning came. It has come up to sing.

bog_body.name: Bog Body

drag.name: Drag Under
drag.text: 4 and 2 Soak to the front hero

bog_body.lore: Tanned by the bog. Leather now, and hungry.

fen_hag.name: Fen Hag

mud.name: Foul Mud
mud.text: 3 and 2 Toxin to the rearmost hero

pool.name: Poison the Water
pool.text: 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Soak to the front hero

fen_hag.lore: She knows the safe path through the fen. She does not share it.

tongue.name: Tongue
tongue.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

spit.name: Poison Spit
spit.text: 3 and 2 Toxin to a random hero

traits.name: Burst Sacs
traits.text: On death its poison sacs burst over the hero who killed it: 2 Toxin.

leech_swarm.name: Leech Swarm

latch.name: Latch On
latch.text: 3 and 2 Bleed to the front hero; heals itself

drain.name: Drain
drain.text: 2 three times to a random hero; heals itself

leech_swarm.lore: The fen's own. They wait in the warm shallows.

fen_lurker.name: Fen Lurker

roll.name: Death Roll
roll.text: 8 and 1 Bleed to the front hero

sink.name: Sink
sink.text: gains 8 Block, dodges the next hit

fen_lurker.lore: A log in the water. Then not.

eel_catcher.name: Eel-Catcher

pin.name: Pin the Foot
pin.text: 6 and Anchored to the front hero

jab.name: Low Jab
jab.text: 5 and Anchored to the hero in rank 2

eel_catcher.lore: Every eel in the Rotmire has bitten him once. He has kept the marks.

stilt_fowler.name: Stilt-Fowler

net.name: Clap-Net
net.text: 4, Anchored and 3 stress to the hero in rank 2

decoy.name: Decoy
decoy.text: gains 5 Block, dodges the next hit

traits.name: Teetering
traits.text: When he is pushed or pulled, he topples: Stunned.

stilt_fowler.lore: He walked the deep fen on stilts to net the wildfowl. He has not come down since.

turf_wife.name: Turf-Wife

settle.name: Settle the Load
settle.text: gains 10 Block, guards the weakest foe

topple.name: Topple the Stack
topple.text: 9 and 1 Toxin to the two front heroes

turf_wife.lore: She cut turf for the village fires and carried it home on her back. The load has taken root.

frog_catcher.name: Frog-Catcher
frog_catcher.lore: He caught frogs for his mother's pot. When the pot ran out he ate them as they came.

lantern_gnats.name: Lantern Gnats

pour.name: Pour off the Lantern
pour.text: 2 three times and 1 Toxin to a random hero

blister.name: Blisters
blister.text: 2 Toxin and 2 stress to the rearmost hero

lantern_gnats.lore: They come to the hags' lamps after dark. So, in the end, do you.

sin_eater.name: Sin-Eater

traits.name: Sins
traits.text: On death the sins he ate spill onto the hero who killed him: 2 Toxin and 5 stress.

sin_eater.lore: Paid a coin to eat the bread off a dead man's chest, and his sins with it. The fen has kept him busy.

leech_barber.name: Leech-Barber

grab.name: Leech Cure
grab.text: 4 and 3 Bleed to the front hero

leech_barber.lore: He bled the whole village for its health. The leeches have grown fond of him.

bog_troll.name: Bog Troll

wade.name: Wading Sweep
wade.text: 6 and 1 Soak to the two front heroes

traits.name: Moss Knits
traits.text: Round start: heals 6, unless it carries Burn.

bog_troll.lore: Moss, mud and muscle. It heals faster than you can cut.

coven_mother.name: Coven Mother

brew.name: Brew the Pool
brew.text: 2 Toxin and 1 Volatile Soak to a random hero

knot.name: Knot the Cord
knot.text: Anchored and 6 stress to the most stressed hero; spends its Knots

curse.name: Spit a Curse
curse.text: 7, 2 Toxin and 3 stress to the rearmost hero

traits.name: Knotting
traits.text: Round start: she ties 1 Knot in her cord. At 3 she binds a hero.

coven_mother.lore: She leads the hags of the fen. Her antlers are not hers.

tithe_reeve.name: The Tithe Reeve

tally.name: Tap the Tally
tally.text: Mark to the most armoured hero; takes their Block

traits.name: Still Taking
traits.text: When a foe falls, he takes its due: gains 8 Block and 1 Might.

tithe_reeve.lore: He took one eel in ten for the hall and the fattest for himself. He is still taking.

midden_sow.name: The Midden Sow

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: 13 and 1 Toxin to the front hero; shoves them back 2

trample.name: Trample
trample.text: 7 and 1 Toxin to the two front heroes

gore.name: Gore
gore.text: 9 and 2 Bleed to the front hero

traits.name: Spore Ridge
traits.text: Every hit on her puffs spores: the hero who hit her gains 1 Toxin (up to 5 times a round).

midden_sow.lore: Every house kept a pig under the floor to eat what fell through. In the Rotmire, a great deal fell through.

mire_mother.name: The Mire Mother

flood.name: Poison Flood
flood.text: 3, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Soak to every hero

weed.name: Drowning Weed
weed.text: 7 and Anchored to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 3

spit.name: Spit the Offerings
spit.text: 4 to every hero; puts Hag's Offering in their hand

traits.name: Mother of the Hags
traits.text: When a hag falls, she swallows its offering: gains 6 Regen.

phases.text: She rises from the fen.
The mouth opens.

mire_mother.lore: The fen's oldest drowned head, swollen to the size of a house. The hags call her Mother.

stilt_hall.name: The Stilt Hall

stamp.name: Stamp the Pile
stamp.text: 8, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Soak to a random hero

reach.name: The Household Reaches
reach.text: 5 and Anchored to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

doors.name: Open the Doors
doors.text: calls Bog Body, builds 1 Household Out

inside.name: Pulled Inside
inside.text: 6, Anchored, 3 Bleed and 6 stress to the most wounded hero

wade.name: Wade the Mere
wade.text: 4, 1 Toxin and 1 Volatile Soak to every hero

traits.name: Household in the Walls
traits.text: Round start: the household grabs the front hero: 1 Toxin.

phases.text: The doors open.
The front piles buckle. The hall lurches forward.

stilt_hall.lore: When the water turned, the village climbed into the moot-hall to wait. In the morning the hall had walked off.

old_heron.name: The Old Heron

spear.name: The Beak Falls
spear.text: 22 to the rearmost hero; spends its Stillness

lift.name: Lift to the Crop
lift.text: 6, Anchored and 1 Toxin to the most wounded hero

gulp.name: Gulp
gulp.text: 15 and 3 Toxin to the most wounded hero

spill.name: The Crop Splits
spill.text: 2 Toxin and 1 Volatile Soak to the two front heroes

traits.name: Still Water
traits.text: Round start: gains 1 Stillness. At 3 the beak falls on the rearmost hero.

phases.text: It begins to feed.
The crop splits.

old_heron.lore: It fished the fen before there were stilts. It has come to prefer the fishermen.

gas_miner.name: Gas-Lung Miner

heavy.name: Wheezing Swing
heavy.text: 6 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

traits.name: Keep It from the Lamp
traits.text: Struck while it Burns, its chest bursts: it takes 10, and the hero who struck it and the foes beside it gain 2 Burn.

gas_miner.lore: Its lungs are full of yellow gas. Keep it away from the lamp.

brimstone_toad.name: Brimstone Toad

spit.name: Burning Slime
spit.text: 3, 2 Toxin and 1 Burn to the rearmost hero

flare.name: Brimstone Sweat
flare.text: 2 and 1 Volatile Burn to the rearmost hero

tongue.name: Tongue
tongue.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

brimstone_toad.lore: Its skin sweats brimstone. Do not lick it.

fuse_imp.name: Fuse Imp

torch.name: Throw the Torch
torch.text: 3 and 1 Volatile Burn to the rearmost hero

blow.name: Blow Up
blow.text: 6 and 2 Burn to every hero; dies

traits.name: Burning Fuse
traits.text: Its tail fuse burns down each round; at 3 it blows up. Soak or Weaken on it puts the fuse out for that round.

fuse_imp.lore: It carries a lit torch into a gas mine. On purpose.

pit_crawler.name: Pit Crawler

bite.name: Venom Mandibles
bite.text: 6 and 2 Toxin to the front hero

coil.name: Coil
coil.text: 7 and Anchored to the front hero

pit_crawler.lore: A centipede as long as a mine cart, and much hungrier.

canary_priest.name: Canary Priest

hymn.name: Hymn to the Gas
hymn.text: 6 stress and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

canary_priest.lore: They sing to the gas the way miners once listened to canaries. The gas listens.

gas_burner.name: Gas-Burner

flame.name: Lift the Flame
flame.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero

gas_burner.lore: He went in first each morning with a flame on a pole to burn off the gas. Somebody had to.

pit_boy.name: Pit Boy

ore.name: Burning Ore
ore.text: 4 and 2 Burn to the rearmost hero

traits.name: Still Seven
traits.text: When he dies, every hero gains 8 stress.

pit_boy.lore: He carried ore up the stairs on his back from the age of seven. He is still seven.

timberman.name: Timberman

prop.name: Set a Prop
prop.text: 2 Fortify to the most wounded foe; 10 Block

timberman.lore: He set the props that held the roof up. He still carries one everywhere, in case.

gallery_rats.name: Gallery Rats

pour.name: Pour Over
pour.text: 2 three times to the front hero

burst.name: Swollen Rat Bursts
burst.text: 3 and 2 Burn to the front hero

gallery_rats.lore: They ate the miners' bread, then the miners' candles. What they ate burns.

weighman.name: Weighman

short.name: Found It Short
short.text: 3 to the front hero; takes their Block

weighman.lore: He weighed every load that came up and found it short. He has never once been wrong.

lamp_room_girl.name: Lamp-Room Girl

hand_hero.name: Everyone Takes One
hand_hero.text: A random hero: puts Lit Lamp in their hand

throw.name: Thrown Lamp
throw.text: 4 and 2 Burn to the rearmost hero

lamp_room_girl.lore: She hands every miner his lamp at the start of the shift. Everyone takes one.

tub_hurrier.name: Tub Hurrier

drag.name: Drag the Burning Tub
drag.text: 4 and 1 Burn to the two front heroes

tub_hurrier.lore: Chained to the tub at the waist, she dragged it from the face to the shaft. She drags it full or empty.

powder_ogre.name: Powder Ogre

belch.name: Fiery Belch
belch.text: 6 and 2 Burn to the two front heroes

bash.name: Keg Bash
bash.text: 13 through Block to the front hero

keg.name: The Keg Goes Off
keg.text: 9 and 2 Volatile Burn to every hero; loses 20 HP, spends its Fuse

traits.name: Lit Fuse
traits.text: The fuse on its wrist burns down each round; at 4 the keg goes off and tears into the ogre too. Soak on it puts the fuse out for that round.

powder_ogre.lore: It eats blasting powder. It burps fire.

miasma_matriarch.name: Miasma Matriarch

gaze.name: Swollen Gaze
gaze.text: 12 stress and Vulnerable to the rearmost hero

choke.name: Choke
choke.text: 8 through Block and 2 Toxin to the most wounded hero

traits.name: Swollen with Gas
traits.text: Struck while she Burns, she bursts in a cloud: she takes 12 and every hero gains 2 Toxin.

miasma_matriarch.lore: A head swollen with gas, drifting through the galleries.

mounted_overseer.name: The Mounted Overseer

lash.name: Whip Lash
lash.text: 6 and Mark to the rearmost hero

cudgel.name: Cudgel
cudgel.text: 10 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

traits.name: Counting Heads
traits.text: When another foe dies he pegs the tally: every foe gains 1 Might.

mounted_overseer.lore: He rode the galleries on a pit pony, counting heads. Neither of them has lost count.

shrine_bearer.name: The Shrine-Bearer

bless_gas.name: Bless the Gas
bless_gas.text: 10 and 2 Volatile Burn to the two front heroes; spends its Votive Lamps

bless_powder.name: Bless the Powder
bless_powder.text: Every foe: 9 Block, spends its Votive Lamps

traits.name: Votive Lamps
traits.text: Lights one more lamp each round; a blessing spends them all.

shrine_bearer.lore: He carried the little chapel down every shaft to bless the powder. He was carrying it when the powder answered.

burning_lung.name: The Burning Lung

inhale.name: Inhale
inhale.text: Every hero: strips their Toxin, builds 2 Gas Sac, gains 10 Block

exhale.name: Exhale
exhale.text: 6, 2 Toxin and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero; spends its Gas Sac

swallow.name: The Tongue
swallow.text: 9 and 6 stress to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 3

burn.name: Burning Breath
burn.text: 3, 1 Toxin and 1 Burn to every hero

deep.name: The Last Inhale
deep.text: Every hero: strips their Toxin, builds 2 Gas Sac, gains 14 Block

last.name: The Last Breath
last.text: 10, 2 Toxin and 2 Volatile Burn to every hero; spends its Gas Sac

traits.name: Gas Sac
traits.text: While the sac holds gas, a hit while it Burns sets the sac off: it takes 14 and the sac empties.

traits.name: Split Skin
traits.text: Below about half HP its skin is split, and it gains 4 Burn every round (2 after its resistance).

phases.text: The skin splits and the gas inside catches. It burns itself, and it breathes fire every round.
The last breath. It draws in the whole gallery.

burning_lung.lore: The mine's first breath, grown into a toad the size of a chapel. Every breath it takes is fire.

owner.name: The Owner

grab.name: Lift to the Chest
grab.text: 8, Anchored and 3 Burn to a random hero

ledger.name: The Owner's Due
ledger.text: 6 stress and 1 Toxin to every hero

reach.name: Both Hands Down
reach.text: 9 and 1 Burn to the two front heroes

lamp.name: The Lamp Drops
lamp.text: 4 and 2 Volatile Burn to every hero

traits.name: Lamp in His Fist
traits.text: If he is Stunned or Frozen, he drops the lamp into the gas: every hero gains 2 Volatile Burn.

phases.text: The timbers creak. He slips lower, and his hands reach the front two ranks at once.
He drops the lamp into the gas.

owner.lore: He came down the shaft once, to see the gas for himself. He has swollen too fat to go back up.

powder_mill.name: The Powder Mill

crush.name: The Full Turn
crush.text: 26 and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero; spends its Quarter Turns

flash.name: The Trough Flashes
flash.text: 15 and 2 Volatile Burn to the two front heroes; spends its Quarter Turns

traits.name: Quarter Turns
traits.text: The stone grinds a quarter turn each round; on the full turn the mill rolls forward and crushes the front hero. Soak on it slows it for a round.

traits.name: Iron Tyre
traits.text: Hits on the iron tyre throw sparks: the attacker gains 1 Burn.

phases.text: The harness burns into the hide. The count drops to two, and each crush flashes the trough under the second rank.
The horse goes down in the traces, and the stone runs free.

powder_mill.lore: It ground the brimstone for the world's powder. The horse has never been unhitched.

saint_unending.name: The Saint Unending

hollow.name: Hollow Flame
hollow.text: 10, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero

chains.name: Chains of Devotion
chains.text: 8 and Anchored to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

black.name: The Black Pyre
black.text: 3, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

traits.name: The Fire Does Not Stop
traits.text: Round start: every hero who is Burning gains 1 Burn.

traits.name: Burning Out
traits.text: Below a quarter of her HP the fire eats her too: she loses 8 HP each round.

phases.text: The flame turns black. Every fire she lays now burns without end.
Nothing is left of her but the fire.

saint_unending.lore: She was burned for heresy. She has been burning for nine hundred years, and she has not stopped praying.

iron_bull.name: The Iron Bull

bellow.name: The Bellow
bellow.text: 6 stress, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

seams.name: The Seams Split
seams.text: 3, 10 stress, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

traits.name: The Hearth
traits.text: Round start: the hearth heats it (+1 Might). If it is Soaked, the heat goes out instead and it loses all its Might.

phases.text: The seams split. The voices inside are heard all at once.
The hearth roars. The bull walks off its bricks.

iron_bull.lore: The heretics were put inside to be heard. They are still being heard.

recanter.name: Recanter

tip.name: Tip the Candle
tip.text: 4, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to a random hero

drip.name: Black Wax
drip.text: 2 Burn to the two front heroes

traits.name: Afraid to Arrive
traits.text: When hit, it shuffles back one rank.

recanter.lore: He recanted, and was spared the fire. He must wear the coat until he dies. He has not died.

confessor.name: The Confessor

grille.name: To the Grille
grille.text: 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 3, takes their Block

burn.name: Then Burn
burn.text: 5 stress, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to every hero

traits.name: The Grille
traits.text: A hero who strikes it confesses: they lose all their Block and Momentum.

phases.text: Then burn, to be certain.
The curtain burns away. There is no more absolution.

confessor.lore: Confess, and be forgiven. Then burn, to be certain.

unburnt_inquisitor.name: The Unburnt Inquisitor

accuse.name: Accuse
accuse.text: 8 stress and Mark to the most stressed hero

sentence.name: The Sentence
sentence.text: 10 and 2 Burn to the Marked hero

verdict.name: Verdict
verdict.text: 13 through Block to the front hero

traits.name: The Accused
traits.text: Round start: every Marked hero gains 4 stress.

unburnt_inquisitor.lore: He burned a thousand saints and never caught alight himself. He wonders why.

pyre_seraph.name: Pyre Seraph

dive.name: Dive of Black Fire
dive.text: 11, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero

rise.name: Rise Out of Reach
rise.text: gains 10 Block, dodges the next 2 hits

traits.name: Scattered Ash
traits.text: On death: its ash scatters; every hero catches 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn (Hollow Flame).

pyre_seraph.lore: An angel sent to put out the pyre. It went in to look.

questioner.name: The Questioner

iron.name: Put to the Question
iron.text: 8, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero

irons.name: Every Iron in the Fire
irons.text: 6, 2 Erode and 2 Volatile Burn to the two front heroes; spends its Irons

tongs.name: The Tongs
tongs.text: 8 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

traits.name: The Brazier
traits.text: Round start: he heats one more iron.

questioner.lore: He asks each question once. He has a great many irons in the fire.

bellows_sister.name: The Bellows Sister

pump.name: Hard Pump
pump.text: 5, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the two front heroes

traits.name: The Fire Burns Low
traits.text: On death: for the first time in nine hundred years the fire burns low; every hero loses 2 ailment stacks.

bellows_sister.lore: Nine hundred years at the bellows. The fire has not once burned low.

ash_penitent.name: Ash Penitent

penance.name: Penance
penance.text: 8 stress and 1 Erode to the rearmost hero

traits.name: Self-Scourging
traits.text: Round start: it whips itself, losing 2 HP and gaining 1 Might.

ash_penitent.lore: It whips itself with the chain between swings at you. It does not notice the difference.

cinder_hound.name: Cinder Hound

hunt.name: Smell the Dying
hunt.text: 8 and 1 Burn to the most wounded hero

ember.name: Ember Bite
ember.text: 4 and 2 Burn to the most wounded hero

cinder_hound.lore: It runs on ash and smells the dying.

censer_deacon.name: Censer Deacon

smoke.name: Black Incense
smoke.text: 1 Erode and 4 stress to every hero

swing.name: Censer Swing
swing.text: 6 and 1 Burn to the front hero

censer_deacon.lore: Its censer burns something that was once a saint.

candle_wraith.name: Candle Wraith

flare.name: Flare
flare.text: 4, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the rearmost hero

traits.name: It Lights Again
traits.text: Round start: unless it is Soaked, its flame feeds it and it heals 4.

candle_wraith.lore: A skull in a black flame. Blow it out and it lights again.

pyre_knight.name: Pyre Knight

mace.name: Black Mace
mace.text: 6, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero

pyre_knight.lore: He lit the pyre. He stands guard so it is never put out.

belfry_bats.name: Belfry Bats

dive.name: The Swirl Dives
dive.text: 2 twice, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the rearmost hero

belfry_bats.lore: The bell tower burned. The bats did not leave.

familiar.name: The Familiar

butt.name: Rearing Butt
butt.text: 5, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the front hero; shoves them back 1

familiar.lore: The court found it guilty of being her familiar. It was burned beside her. It walked out of the ash first.

faggot_bearer.name: Faggot-Bearer

tip.name: Tip the Bundles
tip.text: 6 and 2 Burn to the front hero

traits.name: Burning Load
traits.text: A hero who strikes it catches 1 Burn from the load.

faggot_bearer.lore: Every pyre needs wood. He has carried enough for nine hundred years of them.

scold.name: The Scold

cry.name: Choked Cry
cry.text: 6 stress, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to the most stressed hero

traits.name: He Finally Says It
traits.text: On death: he says it at last; every hero sheds 8 stress.

scold.lore: He cried out in the nave that the saint was innocent. They gave him a mask with an iron tongue. He is still trying to say it.

ash_pardoner.name: Ash Pardoner

ash.name: A Pinch of Saint's Ash
ash.text: 4, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Burn to a random hero

ash_pardoner.lore: A pinch of saint's ash, sealed in lead, for every sin. He has sold her many times over.

charred_destrier.name: Charred Destrier
charred_destrier.lore: It carried the knights to the pyre. It still knows the way.

rime_thrall.name: Rimeburnt Thrall

chip.name: Chip Away
chip.text: 5 and Vulnerable to the front hero

rime_thrall.lore: Miners who dug too deep and met the fire coming up. The ice kept what the fire left.

magma_hound.name: Magma Hound

bite.name: Burning Bite
bite.text: 6 and 2 Burn to the front hero

magma_hound.lore: Its skin is cooling rock. Its insides are not.

obsidian_maiden.name: Obsidian Shieldmaiden

cut.name: Glass Edge
cut.text: 7 and 2 Bleed to the front hero

bash.name: Shield Bash
bash.text: 6 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

traits.name: Glass Edges
traits.text: A hero who hits her is cut by the glass: it takes 2.

obsidian_maiden.lore: Her armour is the volcano's glass. It cuts her as often as it cuts you.

steam_wraith.name: Steam Wraith

scald.name: Scalding Embrace
scald.text: 6 and 2 Burn to the front hero

breath.name: Breath of the Deep Ice
breath.text: 1 Weaken and 4 stress to every hero

steam_wraith.lore: What rises when fire meets ice. It remembers being a man.

fissure_worm.name: Fissure Worm

gnaw.name: Gnaw
gnaw.text: 3 twice and 1 Bleed to the two rear heroes

fissure_worm.lore: It swims through glacier like water. The ice closes behind it.

fire_setter.name: Fire-Setter

bundle.name: The Burning Bundle
bundle.text: 5 and 3 Burn to the rearmost hero; builds 1 Kindling

bucket.name: The Bucket Thrown After
bucket.text: 3 and 2 Volatile Weaken to the rearmost hero; spends its Kindling

fire_setter.lore: The miners split rock with fire, then cold water. The mountain learned the trick from them.

skald.name: The Skald

verse.name: Another Verse
verse.text: 4 stress to every hero; builds 1 Verse

last.name: The Last Verse
last.text: 9 stress to every hero; spends its Verse

skald.lore: He kept the hold's saga in his head. He is adding the last verse.

mead_bearer.name: Mead-Bearer

horn.name: The Horn
horn.text: 4 Empower to the most wounded foe; heals 8

shelter.name: Step Back
shelter.text: gains 8 Block, dodges the next hit

mead_bearer.lore: She filled the horns at the jarl's table. The mead boils in the horn and freezes on the lip.

ore_hauler.name: Ore-Hauler

swing.name: Heave the Sledge Round
swing.text: 6 and 2 Burn to the two front heroes; spends its Strain

traits.name: The Load Spills
traits.text: When he falls, the burning ore spills over the two front heroes: 3 Fire each.

ore_hauler.lore: Thralls hauled the ore up from the deep shaft. The last load came up burning.

snow_hare.name: Snow Hare

listen.name: Listen
listen.text: builds 1 Listening, dodges the next hit

drum.name: Drum the Ice
drum.text: 2 Burn and 1 Volatile Weaken to a random hero; spends its Listening

snow_hare.lore: It came down off the glacier for the moss the vents had thawed. It was there when the ice broke.

pit_adder.name: Pit Adder

bite.name: The Bite Burns
bite.text: 5, 2 Bleed and 2 Burn to the front hero; builds 1 Venom

cold.name: Then Freezes
cold.text: 4 and 2 Volatile Weaken to the front hero; spends its Venom

traits.name: Coiled
traits.text: A hero who hits it is struck back: it takes 3.

pit_adder.lore: The jarl threw his enemies to the adders. When the hold split, the pit split with it, and the adders came up warm.

glacier_wolverine.name: Glacier Wolverine

bite.name: Tearing Bite
bite.text: 6 and 3 Bleed to the front hero

glacier_wolverine.lore: It went down the shaft for the dead and found them cooked. It keeps coming back.

jotun_thane.name: Jötun Thane

traits.name: Melting
traits.text: At round start he loses 4 HP and gains 1 Might.

jotun_thane.lore: A giant of the old ice. The fire in the deep has driven him mad with heat.

twin_seeress.name: Twinflame Seeress

flame.name: Flame Face
flame.text: 6 and 3 Burn to the rearmost hero

rime.name: Rime Face
rime.text: 6 and 3 Weaken to the front hero

turn.name: The Faces Turn
turn.text: 1 Volatile Burn and 1 Volatile Weaken to every hero

traits.name: Two Faces
traits.text: A hero who hits her while carrying Fire gains 1 Volatile Frost; one carrying Frost gains 1 Volatile Fire.

twin_seeress.lore: One face burns. The other has frozen solid. Both speak at once.

berserker.name: Berserker

gang.name: Berserkergang
gang.text: 6 twice to the two front heroes

traits.name: Wounds Feed Him
traits.text: Each hit he takes adds 2 to his next blow.

berserker.lore: He walked into the fire on purpose. He walked out again, and kept fighting.

musk_ox.name: Musk Ox

horn.name: Horn-Boss Charge
horn.text: 11 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

stampede.name: Stampede
stampede.text: 7 to the two front heroes; shoves them back 1
