herd.text: The most wounded foe: guards an ally, 8 Block

shake.name: Shake the Ice
shake.text: 1 Weaken and 5 stress to every hero

traits.name: Frozen Curtain
traits.text: At round start, if it has less than 3 Armor, its coat freezes again: it gains 1 Armor.

musk_ox.lore: The hold yoked them to the ore sledges. The fire came up under the herd.

riven_jarl.name: The Riven Jarl

cleave.name: Riven Cleave
cleave.text: 9, 1 Burn and 1 Weaken to the two front heroes

hoar.name: Hoarfrost Crown
hoar.text: 2 Weaken and 6 stress to every hero

shatter.name: Shatter
shatter.text: 13 and Vulnerable to the rearmost hero

split.name: The Split Runs Through
split.text: 6, 1 Volatile Burn and 1 Volatile Weaken to every hero

crack.name: Burns and Freezes
crack.text: 12, 2 Volatile Burn and 1 Volatile Weaken to the front hero; loses 6 HP

traits.name: Two Halves
traits.text: At round start, if he has no Ward, the leading half gains 1 Ward.

phases.text: The frozen half cracks away. Fire pours out.
He burns and freezes at once.

riven_jarl.lore: Half his body froze in the fall, half burned. He rules the split between.

sleeper_under_the_hold.name: The Sleeper Under the Hold

breath.name: Slow Breath
breath.text: 1 Burn and 1 Weaken to every hero

hand.name: The Hanging Hand
hand.text: 12 and 2 Weaken to the two front heroes

gust.name: Burning Gust
gust.text: 6 and 2 Volatile Burn to every hero; spends its Heat

deep.name: Breath of the Old Ice
deep.text: 2 Weaken and 5 stress to every hero

traits.name: The Galleries
traits.text: At round start, if she carries Fire, her adits glow: she gains 1 Heat.

phases.text: She stirs. The hand comes down.
She wakes.

sleeper_under_the_hold.lore: The hold was built on the glacier, and the glacier on her. The miners found her ribs first.

firstbreaker.name: The Firstbreaker

chain.name: Hoist Chain
chain.text: 7 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 2

double.name: Frost from the Rim, Fire from Below
double.text: 9, 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Burn to the two front heroes

traits.name: The Rim Line
traits.text: Each time he hauls himself into a new phase, the part that comes up cracks: he loses 15 HP.

phases.text: He hauls higher. His chest comes up into the wind.
He is out of the shaft, and the fire comes with him.

firstbreaker.lore: He swung the pick that let the fire in. He has been climbing out ever since.

hollow_wanderer.name: Hollow Wanderer

empty.name: Emptiness
empty.text: 2 Erode and 5 stress to the front hero

hollow_wanderer.lore: It walks the tundra looking for its face.

silence_stag.name: Silence Stag

stamp.name: Stamp
stamp.text: 5 and Stun to the front hero

traits.name: No Sound When It Runs
traits.text: Struck by a hero who moved this round, it is already gone: it dodges the next hit.

silence_stag.lore: It makes no sound when it runs. It makes no sound when it kills.

starless_eye.name: Starless Eye

stare.name: Starless Stare
stare.text: 8 stress and 1 Erode to the rearmost hero

ray.name: Cold Ray
ray.text: 6 and 1 Weaken to a random hero

traits.name: Torn Edge
traits.text: On death: its torn void edge spills 2 Erode on the hero who killed it.

starless_eye.lore: An eye that fell from the black star. It is still looking for the rest of the face.

frozen_saint.name: Frozen Saint

blessing.name: Cold Blessing
blessing.text: 2 Weaken to the two front heroes

frozen_saint.lore: It prayed for warmth. The black star answered.

envelop.name: Envelop
envelop.text: 4 and 1 Volatile Weaken to the front hero

creep.name: Long Shadow
creep.text: 6 and 1 Weaken to the rearmost hero

ice_fisher.name: Ice-Fisher

jerk.name: Jerk the Line
jerk.text: 4 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

traits.name: Something Is Nibbling
traits.text: Struck by a hero in rank 1, the line goes taut: that hero gains 1 Erode.

ice_fisher.lore: It has been jigging that hole since the star rose. Something is nibbling.

hush_child.name: Hush-Child

wail.name: Silent Wail
wail.text: 8 stress to the most stressed hero

traits.name: The Cry Stops
traits.text: On death: every hero sheds 8 stress.

hush_child.lore: It cries without stopping. Be grateful you cannot hear it.

lemming_drift.name: Lemming Drift

gnaw.name: Gnaw
gnaw.text: 2 four times to the front hero

pour.name: Pour Over
pour.text: 3 and 1 Weaken to the two front heroes

lemming_drift.lore: There were always too many of them. There are fewer now. They have not noticed.

lead_dog.name: Lead Dog

drag.name: Drag
drag.text: 5 to the hero in rank 2; drags them forward 1

lead_dog.lore: It still leads the team. The team is behind it somewhere.

sledge_hauler.name: Sledge Hauler

slip.name: Slip Back
slip.text: 6 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

sledge_hauler.lore: The dogs died first. She took the strap. She has not put it down.

silent_singers.name: The Silent Singers

song.name: A Song No One Hears
song.text: 3 stress and 1 Erode to every hero; builds 1 Verse

full.name: Full Voice
full.text: 9 stress and 1 Erode to every hero; spends its Verse

traits.name: One Laughs
traits.text: Any hit breaks their verse: it resets to 0.

silent_singers.lore: They sang into each other's mouths until one laughed and lost. Neither has lost yet.

snow_house_builder.name: Snow-House Builder

bury.name: Bury
bury.text: 6 and Stun to a random hero

traits.name: A Very Small House
traits.text: Struck by a hero with Taunt, it walls them in: they are Anchored for 2 rounds.

snow_house_builder.lore: It builds a house for each of you. They are very small houses.

pale_hunter.name: The Pale Hunter

arrow.name: Arrow at the Warm
arrow.text: 9 and 4 (if the target has no Missing hp) to the healthiest hero

spear.name: Hunting Spear
spear.text: 9 and 1 Weaken to the rearmost hero

prey.name: Mark the Prey
prey.text: Mark and Vulnerable to the healthiest hero

ground.name: Go to Ground
ground.text: gains 12 Block, dodges the next hit

traits.name: Into the Snow
traits.text: Round start: it fades into the snow and dodges the next hit.

pale_hunter.lore: It hunts the warm. There are not many left.

void_mammoth.name: Void Mammoth

trumpet.name: Trumpet of the Void
trumpet.text: 8 stress and 1 Erode to every hero

traits.name: It Did Not Notice
traits.text: It cannot be Stunned or moved. Each hit on it: it gains 2 Block.

void_mammoth.lore: Its herd died out an age ago. It did not notice.

drum_seer.name: The Drum-Seer

beat.name: One Hard Beat
beat.text: 4 and 2 Weaken to the two front heroes

traits.name: The Herds Stop Coming
traits.text: On death: the drumming stops, and every hero sheds 6 stress.

drum_seer.lore: He beat the drum to call the herds home. The herds still come. You will not hear them.

voiceless_chief.name: The Voiceless Chief

point.name: The Baton Points
point.text: Mark and Vulnerable to the busiest hero

traits.name: Still Obeyed
traits.text: Round start: every foe gains 3 Block.

voiceless_chief.lore: He still gives orders. They are still obeyed.

cold_star.name: The Cold Star

chill.name: Stop the Warmth
chill.text: 1 Weaken and 1 Erode to every hero

eye.name: The Eye Opens
eye.text: 6, 1 Erode and 2 Volatile Weaken to the healthiest hero

lance.name: Star Lance
lance.text: 12 and 1 Erode to the rearmost hero

wide.name: It Opens Wider
wide.text: 3 and 1 Volatile Erode to every hero

traits.name: The Warmth Goes
traits.text: Round start: the front hero gains 1 Frost.

traits.name: Warmth Calls to It
traits.text: Each hero who strikes it while carrying Ward feels the warmth drawn out: they gain 1 Erode.

phases.text: It opens wider. Every hero carrying Frost is drained at once.
It comes down. The disc fills the sky, and the small pale moon passes low enough to strike.

cold_star.lore: The black star came down to see what was making all the noise.

unspoken_bear.name: The Unspoken Bear

mouth.name: The Black Mouth
mouth.text: 6, 1 Weaken and 2 Volatile Erode to the front hero

takes.name: The Roar Takes
takes.text: 6 stress and 1 Erode to every hero

traits.name: The Hunters' Rule
traits.text: Each time a hero strikes her, they gain 2 stress, 4 if they struck with 2 or more Momentum.

phases.text: No throat. The black mouth opens, and the roar takes as well as frightens.
She rears to her full height, and the drift on her flank slides away.

unspoken_bear.lore: The hunters never said her name aloud. Now nothing can be said aloud.

hearth_grandmother.name: The Hearth Grandmother

stitch.name: The Stitch
stitch.text: Anchored and 6 stress to a random hero

stitches.name: Two Stitches
stitches.text: Anchored, 5 stress and 1 Erode to the two front heroes

hearth.name: The Cold Hearth
hearth.text: 4, 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Erode to every hero

traits.name: Waiting to Be Fitted
traits.text: Round start: every other foe gains 4 Block.

traits.name: Cut Loose
traits.text: Below half HP: each time a foe falls she gains 1 Might.

phases.text: None of them fit. She cuts the failed masks loose, and the stitch takes two.
Where the hearth burned there is only a round black hole.

hearth_grandmother.lore: She sews new faces for the ones who lost theirs. None of them fit.

rift_hound.name: Rift Hound

phase.name: Lunge From a Rift
phase.text: 6 and 1 Erode to the rearmost hero

rift_hound.lore: It comes through the tears in the sky. Things that should not be followed it.

shattered_god.name: The Shattered God

seep.name: Void Seeps
seep.text: 2 Erode to the hero in rank 2

burns.name: The Burns
burns.text: 8 and 2 Static to the hero in rank 3

veil.name: The Veil Slips
veil.text: 1 Erode and 10 stress to the rearmost hero

flare.name: The Burns Flare
flare.text: 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

shatter.name: Shattered
shatter.text: 4, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

traits.name: Through the Cracks
traits.text: Round start: void leaks from a crack, and a Rift Hound comes through into an empty rank (3 a fight).

phases.text: The cracks open. Void leaks out of her, and the burns begin to flare.
Shattered. The pieces fly apart, and the Tooth hangs bare where her heart was.

shattered_god.lore: She held all six courses in one body, and the world was whole. The void betrayed her, and now it is all that runs out of her.

wheel_of_thrones.name: The Wheel of Thrones

eyes.name: The Eyes Roll Past
eyes.text: 2 Static to the two front heroes

hub.name: The Hub Eye Opens
hub.text: 4, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to every hero; spends its Spin

traits.name: Turning Rims
traits.text: A hero who strikes it gains 1 Static, every hit.

phases.text: It spins up. The hub eye stirs.
It has found the weight.

wheel_of_thrones.lore: It carried the god's seat. It is still turning, looking for the weight.

fourfold_beast.name: The Fourfold Beast

man.name: Where the Man Was
man.text: 2 Erode and 2 Volatile Static to the hero in rank 2

ox.name: Where the Ox Was
ox.text: 2 Erode and 2 Volatile Static to the hero in rank 3

eagle.name: Where the Eagle Was
eagle.text: 2 Erode and 2 Volatile Static to the rearmost hero

voids.name: Three Voids
voids.text: 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

traits.name: It Watches
traits.text: A hero who strikes it gains 3 stress.

phases.text: Only the lion. It stops turning.
The wings open, and every eye in them turns to the company.

fourfold_beast.lore: It had a face for each wind, to watch the throne from every side. The void took three of them.

thunder_seraph.name: Thunder Seraph

spear.name: Strike Down the Spear
spear.text: 10 and 2 Static to the rearmost hero

judgement.name: Judgement
judgement.text: 6, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to the front hero

traits.name: Losing the Tear
traits.text: Round start: below half HP it is losing the tear; a Rift Hound comes through into an empty rank (2 a fight).

thunder_seraph.lore: It holds the sky together with its spear. It is losing.

rift_leviathan.name: Rift Leviathan

teeth.name: Gold Teeth
teeth.text: 9 and 1 Erode to the hero in rank 2

coil.name: Coil Away
coil.text: gains 12 Block, dodges the next hit

traits.name: Between the Stars
traits.text: Round start: it slips through the tear and surfaces again; the first hit each round misses it.

rift_leviathan.lore: It swims in the space between the stars.

recording_angel.name: The Recording Angel

strike.name: Strike the Name
strike.text: 2 Blight, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to the most wounded hero

traits.name: The Names Restored
traits.text: On death: the struck names are restored; every hero's heal-block (Blight) ends.

recording_angel.lore: It wrote down every soul. It has started crossing them out.

weigher_of_souls.name: The Weigher of Souls

weigh.name: Weigh the Soul
weigh.text: 2 Erode and 2 Volatile Static to the healthiest hero

ash.name: Ash of Souls
ash.text: 1 Erode and 4 stress to every hero

traits.name: The Needle
traits.text: Round start: the needle swings over the two front heroes; each gains 1 Static.

weigher_of_souls.lore: It weighed every soul against a feather. It has lost the feather.

fallen_angel.name: Fallen Angel

smite.name: Smite
smite.text: 5 and 2 Static to the rearmost hero

traits.name: It Has Not Stopped Fighting
traits.text: On death: it strikes the hero who felled it once more for 7.

fallen_angel.lore: It fell when the void tore the sky, and it has not stopped fighting.

arc.name: Arc
arc.text: 3 and 1 Volatile Static to the rearmost hero

traits.name: The Last Strike
traits.text: On death: its last strike discharges into the front hero (1 Volatile Static).

choir_of_eyes.name: Choir of Eyes
choir_of_eyes.lore: The eyes of the dead god, singing its last hymn.

skywreck_knight.name: Skywreck Knight

lance.name: Lance Charge
lance.text: 7 and Stun to the front hero

skywreck_knight.lore: A knight of the heavenly host, his armour fused in the fall.

porter_of_heaven.name: Porter of Heaven

key.name: Swing the Key
key.text: 8 and Stun to the front hero

porter_of_heaven.lore: It kept the gate. The gate is gone. It still has the key.

herald_of_heaven.name: Herald of Heaven

sound.name: Sound the End
sound.text: 5 stress, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to the two front heroes

herald_of_heaven.lore: It was sent to sound the end of the world. It is still sounding it. This is how long that takes.

putto.name: Putto

arrow.name: Loosed Arrow
arrow.text: 3, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to the rearmost hero

putto.lore: Heaven kept them for decoration. They have found other work.

scorched_doves.name: Scorched Doves

dive.name: The Flock Dives
dive.text: 2 twice, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to a random hero

scorched_doves.lore: The doves of heaven carried its messages. The messages are bad now.

throne_lion.name: Throne Lion
throne_lion.lore: Twelve lions stood on the steps of the throne. The steps fell. The lions did not.

rift_crawler.name: Rift Crawler

bite.name: Eat the Floor
bite.text: 5 to the front hero; takes their Block

rift_crawler.lore: It came in through a tear and has been eating the floor of heaven ever since. Heaven is mostly floor.

star_lighter.name: Star-Lighter

relight.name: Relight a Star
relight.text: 1 Might to the front foe; 8 Block

swing.name: The Dead Star
swing.text: 4, 1 Erode and 1 Volatile Static to a random hero

tinder.name: Tinderbox
tinder.text: 6 and 1 Static to the front hero

star_lighter.lore: It lit the stars every evening. Most of them have gone out. It is doing its best.

stopped_pilgrim.name: Stopped Pilgrim

stare.name: Upward Stare
stare.text: 2 Weaken and 6 stress to the rearmost hero

traits.name: Has Not Blinked
traits.text: Struck by a hero who moved this round, it jerks round to follow: that hero gains 3 stress.

stopped_pilgrim.lore: It came to see the stars stop. It has not blinked since.

clock_sentry.name: Clock Sentry

tick.name: Tick
tick.text: 4 to the front hero; gains 6 Block, builds 1 Tick

tock.name: Tock
tock.text: 11 to the front hero; spends its Tick

clock_sentry.lore: Tick, then tock. Always in that order. Plan for it.

gear_spider.name: Gear Spider

web.name: Copper Web
web.text: 3 and Anchored to the front hero

needle.name: Needle Leg
needle.text: 6 and 1 Static to the rearmost hero

gear_spider.lore: It repairs the orrery. It considers you a fault.

aurora_moth.name: Aurora Moth

dust.name: Aurora Dust
dust.text: 1 Weaken and 1 Static to every hero

dazzle.name: Dazzling Beat
dazzle.text: 8 stress to the most stressed hero

aurora_moth.lore: Drawn to the frozen stars. Its wings carry the northern lights.

frozen_halberdier.name: Frozen Halberdier

hook.name: Hook and Haul
hook.text: 5 to the rearmost hero; drags them forward 1

sweep.name: Pole Sweep
sweep.text: 5 and 1 Weaken to the two front heroes

frozen_halberdier.lore: A guard frozen mid-patrol. It finishes the patrol now.

ephemeris_clerk.name: Ephemeris Clerk

quill.name: Quill Flick
quill.text: 6 and 1 Static to the Marked hero

ephemeris_clerk.lore: It worked out where every star would be for the next hundred years. It is still right.

college_tortoise.name: The College Tortoise

bite.name: Slow Crushing Bite
bite.text: 12, 1 Weaken and 1 Lockdown to the front hero

traits.name: Two Hundred Years
traits.text: Struck by a hero who has played 3 or more cards this round, it draws in: it gains 6 Block.

college_tortoise.lore: The college kept it to show each new scholar how long a life can last. It is still making the point.

patroness.name: The Patroness

spyglass.name: Through the Spyglass
spyglass.text: Mark and Vulnerable to the most wounded hero

patroness.lore: She paid for the spire so she could watch the stars stop. She is getting her money's worth.

patroness_monkey.name: The Patroness's Monkey

steal.name: Leap and Bite
steal.text: 5 to the Marked hero; takes their Block

traits.name: Light Fingers
traits.text: Struck by a hero with Momentum, it snatches the pace from them: it gains 1 Dodge.

patroness_monkey.lore: It came up the spire on a brass chain for the last night. It stole a star-glass on the way.

speculum_bearer.name: Speculum Bearer

wall.name: Mirror Wall
wall.text: gains 6 Block, guards the weakest foe

flash.name: The Mirror Flashes
flash.text: 1 Weaken and 1 Static to a random hero

traits.name: Face-Out
traits.text: Struck by a hero carrying any course, the mirror flashes it back: that hero gains 1 Static.

speculum_bearer.lore: The great mirror was too heavy for two men. They gave it to one.

clock_jack.name: Clock Jack

strike.name: Strike the Bell
strike.text: 6, Stun and 10 stress to the front hero; spends its Hours

traits.name: Saving Up
traits.text: Round start: it saves 1 hour; at 3 it strikes the bell. Soak in its works stops the saving.

clock_jack.lore: It struck the hours. There have been none to strike. It has been saving up.

gate_mastiff.name: Gate Mastiff

bite.name: Chain-Length Bite
bite.text: 7 and Anchored to the front hero

traits.name: Barks at Strangers
traits.text: Struck by a hero who moved this round, it lunges back: that hero takes 3.

gate_mastiff.lore: Chained at the gate to bark at strangers. It has not finished barking.

horologist.name: The Horologist

click.name: Click of the Watch
click.text: 1 Lockdown and 1 Weaken to the hero who led the last Ordo

spark.name: Escapement Spark
spark.text: 9 and 2 Static to the rearmost hero

traits.name: The Hours Move Again
traits.text: On death: every hero sheds 2 ailment stacks.

horologist.lore: The last astronomer. He keeps the hours from moving.

rime_colossus.name: Rime Colossus

grip.name: Freezing Grip
grip.text: 8 and 2 Weaken to the front hero

traits.name: The Key
traits.text: Round start: the key turns once. On the fourth turn it spends the round rewinding and is Vulnerable.

rime_colossus.lore: An ice statue of the founder. Someone wound it up.

gin_ox.name: The Gin Ox

trudge.name: Trudge the Circle
trudge.text: 12 to the front hero; shoves them back 1

traits.name: The Dome Has Stopped
traits.text: It cannot be Stunned. Each hit on it while it is Anchored or has Weaken finds it still walking: it gains 2 Block for each of the two it has.

gin_ox.lore: It walked the dome round for forty years. The dome has stopped. It has not.

rodwarden.name: The Rodwarden

plant.name: Plant the Pole
plant.text: 6 and 2 Static to the two front heroes; builds 1 Stored Strike

strike.name: The Strike Comes Down
strike.text: 14 and 1 Volatile Static to a random hero; spends its Stored Strike

traits.name: Lightning Rods
traits.text: Round start: he draws all Static off every foe into his rods and stores 1 Strike per Static drawn.

rodwarden.lore: He kept the spire's rods so the lightning went into the ground. Then the ground froze.

last_hour.name: The Last Hour

chime.name: The Chime
chime.text: 2 Lockdown and 4 stress to the hero who led the last Ordo

stop.name: Stop All Clocks
stop.text: 2 Weaken, 1 Static and 6 stress to every hero

midnight.name: Midnight
midnight.text: 8, 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Static to every hero; spends its Minute Hand

traits.name: The Minute Hand
traits.text: Round start: the hand moves one minute toward twelve; at 10 it strikes Midnight whatever its phase, and the hand starts again.

phases.text: The hands spin backwards. Every plan must be read from its end.
Twelve. The pivot is bare, and the world stops every second round.

last_hour.lore: The great clock at the top of the spire. When it strikes twelve, the world stops. It is one minute to.

stilled_college.name: The Stilled College

vote.name: The Vote
vote.text: 6, 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Static to the hero who led the last Ordo

order.name: Point of Order
order.text: 2 Weaken and 6 stress to the rearmost hero

carried.name: The Motion Carried
carried.text: 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Static to every hero

traits.name: Aye
traits.text: Round start: another vote carries: the motion gains 1 Might, up to 3.

traits.name: Out of Order
traits.text: Each hero who strikes it with 2 or more Momentum is ruled out of order: they gain 1 Frost, then 1 Volatile Lightning.

phases.text: The motion carried. The wave breaks forward, and the Vote holds the whole company.
Quorum fails. Every arm swings down at once.

stilled_college.lore: They voted to stop the hour. The motion carried.

great_refractor.name: The Great Refractor

sight1.name: Sighted: Rank 1
sight1.text: 6 and Stun to the front hero

sight2.name: Sighted: Rank 2
sight2.text: 6 and Stun to the hero in rank 2

sight3.name: Sighted: Rank 3
sight3.text: 6 and Stun to the hero in rank 3

sight4.name: Sighted: Rank 4
sight4.text: 6 and Stun to the rearmost hero; spends its Drive

lensf.name: Cracked Lens: Front
lensf.text: 6, 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Static to the two front heroes

lensb.name: Cracked Lens: Rear
lensb.text: 6, 1 Weaken and 1 Volatile Static to the two rear heroes; spends its Drive

traits.name: The Drive
traits.text: Round start: the drive walks the sight one rank back (shown on its intent); after rank 4 it rests a round.

phases.text: The lens cracks across. The sight covers two ranks, and the frosted glass locks both.
The pier groans. The tube swings as much as it sights.

great_refractor.lore: Pointed at the heavens for three hundred years. Someone has turned it round.
